statement_en: In one study of mandarin fish in biofloc systems, the gills were structurally intact but showed varying degrees of damage, such as thickened secondary lamellae and more interlamellar cell mass. The authors suggest this may come from suspended solids touching the gills, while also suggesting biofloc may lessen gill damage from environmental factors, so the claims point in different directions and none directly measure disease or parasites.
statement_zh: 在一项关于biofloc（生物絮团）系统中养殖鳜鱼的研究中，鳃组织结构保持完整，但出现不同程度的组织损伤，如次级鳃小片增生、鳃小片间细胞团体积增大。作者推测这可能是悬浮颗粒物接触鳃丝所致，同时也推测生物絮团系统可能减轻环境因素造成的鳃损伤，两种推断并不一致，且这些结论都没有直接测定疾病或寄生虫情况。

statement_en: Compared to the base breeding population 'Huakang No. 1', the survival rate of the GQ population increased by an average of 12.6%, indicating that immune-related genes were also under selection.
statement_zh: 与基础育种群体“华康一号”相比，GQ群体的存活率平均提高了12.6%，表明免疫相关基因也受到了选择。

statement_en: At 8 days post-hatching, the number of larvae capable of feeding on 5-day-old Artemia was higher in the activin A group than in the BMP4 group and the control group.
statement_zh: 在8日龄时，激活素A组中能够摄食5日龄卤虫的幼虫数量多于BMP4组和对照组。

statement_en: Siniperca chuatsi easily adapts to new environments and has relatively strong disease resistance, but grows slowly; therefore, hybrid strains may be acclimated to feed on frozen and artificial feeds.
statement_zh: 斑鳜容易适应新环境且抗病力相对较强，但生长缓慢，因此杂交种可能被驯化以食用冷冻和人工饲料。

statement_en: This temporal overlap ensures that carp fry are available at the critical moment when mandarin fish begin to feed, making them an ideal live bait for successful aquaculture.
statement_zh: 这种时间上的重叠确保了在鳜鱼开始摄食的关键时刻有鲤鱼苗可用，使其成为成功养殖的理想活体饵料。

statement_en: Once eggs and semen are observed to be discharged from the urogenital pore by gently pressing the abdomen, the eggs and semen are collected.
statement_zh: 一旦观察到通过轻柔按压腹部从泌尿生殖孔排出卵子和精液，即收集卵子和精液。

statement_en: When Ompok bimaculatus were in culture water with a total ammonia nitrogen concentration of 12.19 mg/L, gill tissue damage was less in the biofloc group than in the control group.
statement_zh: 当双斑叉尾鲶(Ompok bimaculatus)处于总氨氮浓度为12.19 mg/L的培养水中时，生物絮团组的鳃组织损伤少于对照组。

statement_en: A significant difference was observed between the allicin treatment group and the blank group (p < 0.05).
statement_zh: 大蒜素处理组与空白组之间观察到显著差异（p < 0.05）。

statement_en: Both claims, from one 2023 paper, are background statements rather than test results. They say that some antimicrobial peptides help regulate the intestinal mucosal barrier and that, as ingredients in compound feed, they help prevent inflammation. No conditions or measured effects on disease or parasites in mandarin fish are given.
statement_zh: 这两条结论来自同一篇2023年的论文，都只是背景性的介绍，并非试验结果。其中提到，部分抗菌肽对调节肠黏膜屏障有明显作用，作为配合饲料中的活性成分，抗菌肽在预防炎症方面也有重要作用。文中没有给出具体条件，也没有给出对鳜鱼疾病或寄生虫的实测效果。

statement_en: The results of this study showed that adding AOAA inhibited SCRV virus production and viral protein expression, but its mechanism of action on virus replication and proliferation requires further research.
statement_zh: 本研究结果显示，添加AOAA抑制了SCRV病毒的产生和病毒蛋白的表达，但其对病毒复制和增殖的作用机制需要进一步研究。

statement_en: At this time, liver fat content was significantly lower than in other groups, indicating that when fed a diet with an appropriate CHO:L ratio, mandarin fish livers can effectively alleviate hepatic lipid accumulation by reducing fatty acid synthesis and increasing fatty acid β-oxidation.
statement_zh: 此时肝脏脂肪含量显著低于其他组，表明在饲喂适当的CHO:L比例日粮时，鳜鱼肝脏可以通过减少脂肪酸合成和增加脂肪酸β氧化来有效缓解肝脏脂肪积累。

statement_en: Literature reports that the majority of enriched taxa in CS support gut homeostasis: Agathobacter is associated with short-chain fatty acid synthesis and host metabolic homeostasis; Oscillibacter is associated with cholesterol metabolism and can alleviate inflammatory responses and oxidative stress; UCG-010 has positive effects on certain specific diseases and is associated with immune and antioxidant functions.
statement_zh: 文献报道CS中富集的多数类群支持肠道稳态：Agathobacter与短链脂肪酸合成及宿主代谢稳态相关；Oscillibacter与胆固醇代谢相关并可缓解炎症反应和氧化应激；UCG-010对某些特定疾病有积极影响并与免疫和抗氧化功能相关。

statement_en: The addition of the natural trace mineral complex Azostone to feed improved the growth, immune response, gut health, and resistance to bacterial infection of largemouth bass.
statement_zh: 饲料中添加天然微量矿物复合物阿佐石改善了大口黑鲈的生长、免疫反应、肠道健康及抗细菌感染能力。

statement_en: Benfotiamine can improve liver oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis in bream induced by a high-carbohydrate diet.
statement_zh: 苯磷硫胺可改善高碳水化合物饮食诱导的鳊鱼肝脏氧化应激、炎症和细胞凋亡。

statement_en: However, excessive supplementation with Bacillus subtilis 1-C-7 (Y3 group) increased the abundance of common pathogens such as Pseudomonas, indicating reduced beneficial effects or harmful impacts, which may disrupt the gut environment and inhibit growth.
statement_zh: 然而，过量补充枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7（Y3组）增加了假单胞菌等常见致病菌的丰度，表明有益效果减弱或产生有害影响，从而可能破坏肠道环境并抑制生长。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, the highest dose of Bacillus subtilis 1-C-7 (Y3) was linked to raised serum liver enzyme activities (ALT and AST) compared with the other groups, and also higher TCHO than the control; Y2 also raised ALT and AST. The authors infer that a relatively high dose may harm growth and health, so the claims point to a possible negative effect rather than a benefit, and they do not directly measure disease or parasites.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼上,高剂量枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7(Y3组)的血清ALT和AST活性在各组中最高,总胆固醇(TCHO)也高于对照组;Y2组的ALT、AST也有升高。作者推测较高剂量可能抑制生长并影响鱼体健康,说明结果更倾向于不利影响而非益处,且这些结果并未直接测定病害或寄生虫情况。

practice_zh: 枯草芽孢杆菌分泌抗菌物质
statement_en: The increased survival rate of mandarin fish after attack by Aeromonas hydrophila may also be attributed to antimicrobial substances secreted by Bacillus subtilis.
statement_zh: 鳜鱼在受嗜水气单胞菌攻击后存活率的提高也可能归因于枯草芽孢杆菌分泌的抗菌物质。

statement_en: In this study, when the dietary carbohydrate-to-lipid ratio (CHO:L) was 1.71, serum total protein (TP), albumin (ALB), alanine aminotransferase (ALT), and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) were significantly lower than in other groups.
statement_zh: 本研究中，当膳食碳水化合物与脂质比例（CHO:L）为1.71时，血清总蛋白（TP）、白蛋白（ALB）、丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）和天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）显著低于其他组。

statement_en: The claims are background statements from one paper and do not test choline in mandarin fish or measure disease or parasite outcomes. They report that dietary choline reduces liver lipid and prevents nutritional fatty liver in fish (brown-marbled grouper at 603-1512 mg/kg), while a very high dose (20,000 mg/kg) in hybrid grouper lowered growth and survival, suggesting toxicity.
statement_zh: 这几条都是同一篇论文引述的背景内容，并非在鳜鱼上开展的试验，也没有涉及疾病或寄生虫方面的结果。它们提到饲料中添加胆碱可降低鱼类肝脏脂质、预防营养性脂肪肝（如在褐点石斑鱼中添加603-1512 mg/kg），而在杂交石斑鱼中添加20,000 mg/kg的高剂量则使生长和成活率下降，提示高浓度可能有毒性。

statement_en: RDA analysis found that goblet cell number and mucus thickness showed varying degrees of negative correlation with tissue damage indicators.
statement_zh: RDA分析发现，杯状细胞数量和黏液厚度与组织损伤指标呈不同程度的负相关。

statement_en: The authors developed a novel antimicrobial peptide reagent, CMCS-gcIFN-20H (CMCS-20H), by combining gcIFN-20H with CMCS, and found that CMCS-20H can delay degradation, prevent bacterial infection, improve the intestinal mucosal barrier, and regulate the gut microbiota.
statement_zh: 作者将gcIFN-20H与CMCS结合开发了新型抗菌肽试剂CMCS-gcIFN-20H（CMCS-20H），发现CMCS-20H可以延缓降解、预防细菌感染、改善肠道黏膜屏障并调节肠道菌群。

practice_en: co-feeding fish mince and formulated feed
practice_zh: 碎鱼肉与配合饲料混合投喂
statement_en: The activities of alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) in the liver significantly increased as the proportion of trash fish decreased.
statement_zh: 肝脏中丙氨酸转氨酶（ALT）和天冬氨酸转氨酶（AST）活性随着碎鱼比例的降低而显著增加。

statement_en: Meanwhile, in the replacement group, the abundance of Mycoplasma decreased to below 0.1%, and Cetobacterium dominated the microbial community (76.7%).
statement_zh: 同时，在替代组中支原体的丰度降至0.1%以下，鲸杆菌主导了微生物群落（76.7%）。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, feeding compound Chinese herbal medicine at 1% and 2% inclusion lowered serum ALT and AST compared with the control, with levels falling further as the dose rose, and raised HDL-C while lowering triglycerides and cholesterol; the authors read this as liver protection through antioxidant, anti-inflammatory and lipid-regulating effects. These claims come from one paper and measure liver-related serum indicators, not disease or parasite outcomes directly.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼饲料中添加1%和2%的复方中草药,与对照组相比血清ALT、AST显著降低,且随添加量增加而下降,同时HDL-C升高、甘油三酯和胆固醇降低;作者认为这是通过增强抗氧化能力、减轻炎症和调节脂质代谢来保护肝脏。这些结果只来自一篇论文,测的是肝脏相关血清指标,并非直接检测疾病或寄生虫的发病情况。

statement_en: PCoA showed significant differences in microbial communities between the EA and DA groups, and the Shannon and Simpson indices were significantly lower in the DA group.
statement_zh: PCoA显示EA组和DA组之间的微生物群落存在显著差异，且DA组的Shannon和Simpson指数显著降低。

statement_en: The two claims, both from one 2023 paper, only describe dietary antioxidant additives in general terms: they are considered an effective way to ease oxidative stress from high-carbohydrate diets and are widely used to guard against environmental stress or nutritional imbalance. Neither claim reports an effect on disease or parasites in mandarin fish.
statement_zh: 这两条结论都来自同一篇2023年的论文,只是笼统地介绍抗氧化饲料添加剂:认为其可有效缓解高碳水化合物饲料引起的氧化应激,并被广泛用于预防环境应激或营养失衡。两条都没有报告对鳜鱼疾病或寄生虫问题的具体影响。

statement_en: The claims give limited evidence on disease for mandarin fish given dietary arginine. One background claim says arginine's effects on immune response and disease resistance in fish are well established, but it is not a measurement in this species. In the measured results, arginine changed the gut bacterial community, and no significant pathological changes were seen in intestinal tissue structure in any group; no disease or parasite outcome is directly reported.
statement_zh: 关于鳜日粮添加精氨酸对疾病问题的影响,现有证据有限。一条背景性陈述称精氨酸对鱼类免疫反应和抗病力的作用已有充分报道,但这并非在鳜上的实测结果。本研究的实测结果显示,精氨酸调节了鳜的肠道菌群,各组肠道组织结构均未见明显病理变化;文中没有直接报告疾病或寄生虫方面的结果。

practice_zh: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌
statement_en: A similar unpublished study conducted in our laboratory showed that host Bacillus subtilis in the diet can enhance the secretion of antimicrobial substances (such as aromatic amino acids and their derivatives), reduce the proliferation of challenge bacteria in the intestines of tilapia, thereby improving the survival rate of tilapia after infection with Streptococcus agalactiae.
statement_zh: 我们实验室进行的一项类似的未发表研究表明，日粮中的宿主枯草芽孢杆菌可以增强抗菌物质（如芳香族氨基酸及其衍生物）的分泌，减少罗非鱼肠道内攻毒细菌的增殖，从而提高罗非鱼感染无乳链球菌后的存活率。

statement_en: In mandarin fish fed high-carbohydrate diets, adding betaine reduced liver oxidative stress, endoplasmic reticulum stress, autophagy, apoptosis and lipid deposition, as measured by antioxidant enzymes, gene expression, histology and staining. These claims concern liver stress and damage rather than infectious disease or parasites, and all of them are supportive; other claims on inflammation in black seabream are only background.
statement_zh: 在饲喂高碳水化合物饲料的鳜鱼中，添加甜菜碱可减轻肝脏的氧化应激、内质网应激、自噬、细胞凋亡和脂质沉积，依据是抗氧化酶、基因表达、组织学和染色结果。这些结果涉及的是肝脏应激和损伤，并非传染病或寄生虫；所有相关结论均为正面，黑鲷炎症方面的内容只是背景引用。

statement_en: The three claims are background statements from one paper, not results in mandarin fish. They say butyrate improves gut health and non-specific immunity in fish in general, and strengthens intestinal immune function and barrier function in juvenile grass carp. None of them tests disease or parasite outcomes in mandarin fish.
statement_zh: 这三条结论都是同一篇论文引用的背景资料,并非针对鳜鱼的试验结果。它们提到丁酸(盐)总体上可改善鱼类肠道健康、提高非特异性免疫,在草鱼幼鱼中还能增强肠道免疫功能和肠道物理屏障功能;但都没有在鳜鱼上检验对疾病或寄生虫的影响。

statement_en: Optimizing feed formulations and feeding strategies aims to enhance disease resistance; high-quality feed must contain balanced nutrition to meet the needs of different stages.
statement_zh: 优化饲料配方和投喂策略旨在提升抗病能力，优质饲料需含均衡营养以满足不同阶段需求。

statement_en: Existing literature records that natural raw food often contains large amounts of resident bacteria and other microorganisms, while thermal processing methods such as drying or extrusion can reduce microbial colonization in artificial feed.
statement_zh: 已有文献记载，天然生食往往含有大量常驻细菌和其他微生物，而干燥或挤压等热处理方法可以减少人工饲料中微生物的定植。

statement_en: Attention to feed storage management can prevent it from becoming a vector for disease transmission.
statement_zh: 注意饲料储存管理可避免其成为疾病传播媒介。

statement_en: Liver samples from fish fed fresh bait showed normal histological structure, with regular and tightly packed hepatocytes.
statement_zh: 饲喂新鲜饵料的鱼的肝脏样本显示正常组织学结构，肝细胞规则且紧密。

statement_en: Two papers, both giving background statements rather than new test results, say that feeding live bait fish to mandarin fish can bring in pathogens or parasites that endanger fish health, and one adds that this can lead to mass mortality. The claims give no conditions or measured effect sizes.
statement_zh: 两篇论文都是在背景介绍中提到,给鳜鱼投喂活饵鱼可能带入病原体或寄生虫,危害养殖鱼的健康,其中一篇还指出可能导致鳜鱼大批死亡。这些说法并非实验结果,也没有给出具体条件或数据。

statement_en: These fermentation products help improve the immune system.
statement_zh: 这些发酵产物有助于改善免疫系统。

statement_en: Different levels of fish protein hydrolysate affect the growth, digestive enzymes, gut microbiota, and resistance to Vibrio anguillarum in juvenile European sea bass.
statement_zh: 不同水平的鱼蛋白水解物对欧洲鲈幼鱼的生长、消化酶、肠道菌群和对鳗弧菌的抵抗力有影响。

statement_en: In addition, the relative abundances of Escherichia-Shigella and Bacteroides in the Fs group were significantly higher than those in all other groups.
statement_zh: 此外，Fs组中埃希氏菌-志贺氏菌属和拟杆菌属的相对丰度显著高于其他各组。

statement_en: Adding probiotics and enzyme preparations can improve gut microecology and enhance immunity.
statement_zh: 添加益生菌和酶制剂可改善肠道微生态，增强免疫力。

statement_en: Although the abundance of the opportunistic pathogen Aeromonas decreased, it also weakened the immune stimulation and competitive balance of the microbial community.
statement_zh: 虽然条件致病菌气单胞菌属的丰度降低了，但也削弱了微生物群落的免疫刺激和竞争平衡。

statement_en: Hesperidin was found to protect Procambarus clarkii from white spot syndrome virus (WSSV) infection by modulating its innate immunity to delay and reduce mortality after WSSV challenge.
statement_zh: 橙皮苷被发现能保护克氏原螯虾免受白斑综合征病毒（WSSV）感染，通过调节其先天免疫来延迟和降低WSSV攻击后的死亡率。

statement_en: Under high-carbohydrate conditions, the gill lamellae and external epithelial layer in freshwater become thicker and more swollen.
statement_zh: 在高碳水化合物条件下，淡水中的鳃小片和外部上皮层会变厚并更加肿胀。

statement_en: The results of this study indicate that Na+/K+-ATPase activity was significantly reduced in the HG2 group, suggesting impaired ammonia nitrogen metabolism in mandarin fish.
statement_zh: 本研究结果表明，HG2组Na+/K+-ATPase活性显著降低，提示鳜鱼的氨氮代谢受损。

statement_en: In the high-carbohydrate/low-fat groups (D4 and D5), serum total cholesterol, triglyceride, and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol levels did not increase, indicating that fatty acids may be primarily stored in hepatic lipid droplets, which may impair fish health.
statement_zh: 在高碳水/低脂组（D4和D5）中，血清总胆固醇、甘油三酯和低密度脂蛋白胆固醇水平未升高，表明脂肪酸可能主要存在于肝脏脂滴中，这可能会损害鱼的健康。

statement_en: Across these claims, high-density or intensive farming of mandarin fish is linked to more disease, especially viral disease such as ISKNV, MRV and SCRV, and to a high rate of infection with the parasite Anchitrema sinense. One claim says poor water quality at high density brings on latent viruses late in farming, and another says temperature swings add to the losses. Most of these are statements from paper backgrounds rather than direct tests, and one claim is about grass carp, not mandarin fish.
statement_zh: 这些研究普遍认为,鳜高密度(集约化)养殖会使病害增多,尤其是传染性脾肾坏死病毒(ISKNV)、鳜虹彩病毒(MRV)和鳜弹状病毒(SCRV)等病毒病,同时华支睾类的中华双腔吸虫(Anchitrema sinense)感染率也较高。有一条提到高密度导致水质恶化,诱发养殖后期潜伏病毒发病;另一条提到环境温度剧烈波动会加重损失。这些说法多为论文背景介绍,并非直接试验结果,其中一条讲的是草鱼而不是鳜。

statement_en: High-level dietary choline supplementation also showed similar negative effects in Senegalese sole and grass carp.
statement_zh: 高水平膳食胆碱补充在塞内加尔鳎和草鱼中也显示出类似的负面影响。

practice_en: high levels of soy protein concentrate
statement_en: However, high levels of soy protein concentrate reduce growth performance, alter intestinal histological structure, trigger inflammatory responses, and impair antioxidant capacity.
statement_zh: 然而，高含量的大豆浓缩蛋白会降低生长性能，改变肠道组织学结构，引发炎症反应，并损害抗氧化能力。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, both claims from one paper report that industrialized farming restructured and simplified the gut microbiota, with homogenization, functions concentrated in single pathways such as genetic information processing, and a less stable microbial community. Both are labelled counterevidence, and neither directly measures disease or parasite outcomes, so the link to disease is not shown.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼中,同一篇论文的两条结论都指出,工厂化养殖使肠道微生物群发生重构并趋于简化,出现同质化,功能集中在遗传信息处理等单一代谢途径,群落稳定性下降。两条均被标为反证,而且都没有直接测定疾病或寄生虫方面的结果,因此与疾病的关联并未得到证实。

statement_en: The genus Lactococcus, belonging to the phylum Firmicutes, is considered the most effective antibiotic alternative and has been widely used in aquaculture.
statement_zh: 属于厚壁菌门的乳球菌属被认为是最有效的抗生素替代品，并已在水产养殖中广泛使用。

practice_en: diets with different lipid and carbohydrate levels
practice_zh: 不同脂质和碳水化合物水平日粮
statement_en: Under dietary conditions with crude fat of 80-120 g/kg and carbohydrates of 40-80 g/kg, the hepatocytes of Chinese perch were arranged uniformly and regularly, with relatively normal morphology, showing only occasional small lipid droplets.
statement_zh: 在粗脂肪80-120 g/kg且碳水化合物40-80 g/kg的日粮条件下，鳜鱼肝细胞排列均匀规则，形态相对正常，仅偶见少量小体积脂滴。

statement_en: This study found that treating mandarin fish with feed MT at doses of 50 mg/kg and 100 mg/kg for 2 months resulted in a survival rate slightly lower than that of the control group.
statement_zh: 本研究发现，以50 mg/kg和100 mg/kg剂量的饲料MT处理鳜鱼2个月，其存活率略低于对照组。

statement_en: Mulberry leaf flavonoids have a protective effect against high-carbohydrate-induced hepatic oxidative stress, inflammatory response, and gut microbiota disorder in ricefield eels.
statement_zh: 桑叶黄酮对黄鳝高碳水化合物诱导的肝脏氧化应激、炎症反应和肠道菌群紊乱具有保护作用。

practice_zh: 其他益生菌、益生元或免疫刺激剂
statement_en: It is worth researching more solutions, such as applying other probiotics, prebiotics or immunostimulants.
statement_zh: 值得研究更多解决方案，例如应用其他益生菌、益生元或免疫刺激剂。

statement_en: In one study, mandarin fish fed pellet feed instead of live bait had lower survival, more pneumonia-related and hospital-acquired human pathogens, signs of oxidative stress (lower intestinal GSH, lower gill CAT, higher gill MDA) and histological changes; the paper also notes that higher mortality under pellet feeding hurts economic returns. All claims point the same way, with no claim showing a benefit or no effect.
statement_zh: 在一项研究中,与投喂活饵相比,投喂颗粒饲料的鳜鱼成活率下降,肺炎相关菌和医院获得性人类病原菌的丰度增加,并出现氧化应激(肠道GSH降低、鳃CAT活性降低、鳃MDA升高)和组织学变化;文中还提到颗粒饲料条件下死亡率升高会严重影响经济效益。所有结论方向一致,没有显示有益或无影响的结果。

statement_en: Studies have shown that adding phospholipids to feed can significantly reduce MDA content in the liver of juvenile snakehead, improve total antioxidant capacity and SOD activity, and alleviate oxidative damage in the liver of juvenile snakehead.
statement_zh: 研究表明，在饲料中添加磷脂可显著降低幼乌鳢肝脏中的MDA含量，提高总抗氧化能力和SOD活性，并减轻幼乌鳢肝脏的氧化损伤。

statement_en: Plant extracts can have antibacterial and antiviral effects and enhance immunity.
statement_zh: 植物提取物可抗菌抗病毒并增强免疫力。

statement_en: The alpha diversity of the GS group was lower than that of the CS group, and beta diversity confirmed highly distinct community characteristics between the two groups (p=0.004).
statement_zh: GS组的α多样性低于CS组，且β多样性证实两组间存在高度不同的群落特征（p=0.004）。

statement_en: The abundance of Aeromonas in the PFDLP, PFDLR and PFDCB groups was significantly lower than that in the PFD group.
statement_zh: PFDLP、PFDLR和PFDCB组中气单胞菌属(Aeromonas)的丰度显著低于PFD组。

statement_en: The claims, mostly background statements from two papers, say probiotics help keep the gut microbiota balanced and are supportive for disease prevention and host welfare, by blocking harmful bacteria, stimulating the immune system and raising resistance to farming stressors. They describe general benefits in aquaculture and do not report a measured effect on disease or parasites in mandarin fish, nor any conditions.
statement_zh: 这些论述大多是两篇论文中的背景性说法,认为益生菌有助于维持肠道菌群平衡,并通过抑制有害菌定植、刺激免疫、提高对养殖应激的抵抗力来预防疾病、有利于鱼体福利。这些说法讲的是水产养殖中的一般作用,并没有给出鳜鱼在疾病或寄生虫方面的实测效果,也没有说明具体条件。

statement_en: The two claims from one paper only describe shifts in bacterial genera in mandarin fish ponds with a rice floating bed (PRFB): Enterobacter rose in the PRFB group but fell in the control, and Mycobacterium rose in both groups. Neither claim reports an effect on disease or parasites, so the effect on this welfare problem is not shown.
statement_zh: 这两条来自同一篇论文的结论只描述了鳜鱼池塘设置水稻浮床(PRFB)后细菌属丰度的变化:肠杆菌属在PRFB组上升、在对照组下降,分枝杆菌属在两组中都上升。两条结论都没有报告对疾病或寄生虫的影响,因此浮床对这一福利问题的作用尚无法判断。

practice_en: excessive replacement of fishmeal with soybean meal
statement_en: However, a series of side effects caused by the excessive use of soybean meal to replace fishmeal have not been completely resolved.
statement_zh: 然而，由过量使用豆粕替代鱼粉引起的一系列副作用尚未完全解决。

practice_en: staged enriched artemia then silver carp fry
practice_zh: 阶段性投喂强化卤虫后转鲢仔鱼
statement_en: Transcriptome and qPCR analysis showed that pathways related to immune inflammation and cell apoptosis were enriched in the experimental group (Group AB), and key genes associated with these pathways were significantly upregulated.
statement_zh: 转录组和qPCR分析显示，实验组（AB组）中与免疫炎症及细胞凋亡相关的通路富集，且相关关键基因显著上调。

statement_en: It can be concluded that the addition of 10% starch to the diet benefits gut health by altering microbial functions.
statement_zh: 可以得出结论，日粮中添加10%淀粉通过改变微生物功能有利于肠道健康。

practice_en: dietary taurine and mulberry leaf flavonoids
practice_zh: 日粮添加牛磺酸和桑叶黄酮
statement_en: For example, studies have shown that dietary taurine and mulberry leaf flavonoids can improve the growth performance of hybrid grouper, turbot, and eel, and alleviate oxidative stress and endoplasmic reticulum stress induced by high-carbohydrate diets.
statement_zh: 例如，研究表明，日粮中的牛磺酸和桑叶黄酮可以改善杂交石斑鱼、大菱鲆和鳗鱼的生长性能，并缓解高碳水化合物日粮诱导的氧化应激和内质网应激。

practice_zh: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯
statement_en: Clostridium butyricum (TB) supplementation improves the productivity and health of farmed animals by enhancing key physiological processes such as intestinal mucosal structure, barrier integrity, antioxidant defense, inflammation regulation, and mitochondrial efficiency.
statement_zh: 丁酸梭菌（TB）补充剂通过改善肠道黏膜结构、屏障完整性以及抗氧化防御、炎症调节和线粒体效率等关键生理过程，从而提高农场动物的生产力和健康水平。

statement_en: In one study, mandarin fish in traditional pond systems had more opportunistic pathogens, fewer beneficial gut bacteria, more Pseudomonadota, and more active disease- and inflammation-related pathways, which the authors say may impair gut health to some extent. A second paper only notes in background that traditional ponds are prone to disease outbreaks.
statement_zh: 一项研究显示,传统池塘养殖的鳜鱼肠道中条件致病菌相对丰度较高、有益菌较少,假单胞菌门(Pseudomonadota)显著增加,与疾病和炎症相关的功能通路也更活跃,作者认为这可能在一定程度上损害了肠道稳态和健康。另一篇文献只是在背景中提到传统池塘养殖容易暴发疾病。

statement_en: Both claims say that feeding mandarin fish a diet with an appropriate carbohydrate-to-lipid ratio improves feed intake and appetite, which helps avoid anorexia during farming; one also notes reduced liver lipid accumulation. Neither claim gives the specific ratio or conditions, and one is background citing earlier work.
statement_zh: 两条结论都认为,给鳜鱼投喂碳水化合物与脂质比例适当的日粮,可提高摄食量、增强食欲,有助于避免养殖过程中出现厌食;其中一条还提到可减少肝脏脂质蓄积。两条均未给出具体比例或条件,且其中一条是引用前人研究的背景性说法。

statement_en: The claims are mixed. Two report problems with training to artificial feed: in one measured trial, 53% of the trained group were emaciated with hollow bellies versus 6% of controls, and a background report links it to poor growth in hybrids, possibly from digestive capacity or unattractive non-moving particles. The other two only say, as background, that mandarin fish can be acclimated to compound feed by special methods and that adaptation is related to intestinal microbiota.
statement_zh: 各项结论不一致。有两条显示驯食人工饲料存在问题:一项实测试验中,驯食组53%的鱼消瘦、腹部凹陷,对照组为6%;另一条背景文献提到杂交鳜驯食后生长不良,可能与消化能力不足或不动的颗粒饲料吸引力低有关。另外两条只是背景性说法,称鳜可通过特殊方法驯化摄食配合饲料,且驯食适应与肠道微生物有关。

practice_en: adjusting bait ratio and stocking density
practice_zh: 调整饵料比与放养密度
statement_zh: 饵料鱼密度保持在鳜鱼幼鱼的约五倍，同时总放养密度调整为每立方米20,000至30,000尾幼鱼。

statement_en: The claims support matching bait fish size to mandarin fish growth stage for effective feeding and development, with bait length kept to about 60% of the fish's body length (or 40-60% of total length) so it can be swallowed and meet nutritional needs. One claim, on round goby predation, only shows that predation varies with prey size. None of the claims reports a measured welfare outcome from size matching itself.
statement_zh: 这些结论都支持按鳜鱼的生长阶段匹配饵料鱼大小,以保证摄食和生长发育;饵料鱼体长一般不超过鳜鱼体长的约60%(或40-60%),这样便于吞咽并满足营养需要。另有一条关于圆鰕虎鱼的结果,只说明捕食情况随猎物大小而不同。以上结论都没有给出匹配大小本身带来福利改善的实测结果。

practice_zh: 高碳水日粮中添加甜菜碱
statement_en: No significant differences were observed among groups in feed efficiency, feeding rate, and other morphological indicators.
statement_zh: 各组间在饲料效率、摄食率和其他形态指标上未观察到显著差异。

practice_en: broken-line analysis for optimal feeding ratio
practice_zh: 折线分析确定最适投喂比例
statement_en: Broken-line analysis of growth weight gain indicates that the optimal feeding ratio for juvenile mandarin fish with body weights between 9.0 g and 37.0 g is approximately 87.7% of satiation, and does not inhibit growth.
statement_zh: 通过生长增重的折线分析表明，体重在9.0克至37.0克之间的鳜鱼幼鱼的最适投喂比例约为饱食度的87.7%，且不会抑制生长。

practice_en: cage keeping with low-value fish feeding
practice_zh: 网箱养殖并投喂低值鱼
statement_en: Both claims, from one paper, only describe the practice: two- and three-year-old mandarin fish were kept only in cages and fed live and dead low-value fish. Neither claim reports an effect on welfare.
statement_zh: 两条结论都出自同一篇论文,只是描述了养殖做法:两龄和三龄鳜鱼只在网箱中饲养,投喂活的和死的低值鱼。两条结论都没有说明这种做法对鱼类福利有什么影响。

practice_en: carbohydrate level and feeding time interaction
practice_zh: 碳水水平与饲喂时间交互
statement_en: 3 indicates that carbohydrate level and feeding time had a significant interaction effect (P < 0.05).
statement_zh: 3表示碳水化合物水平和饲喂时间具有显著的交互效应（P < 0.05）。

statement_en: Compared with other feeds, carp not only reduces rearing costs but is also expected to improve feeding efficiency, providing strong support for the large-scale aquaculture of juvenile mandarin fish.
statement_zh: 与其他饲料相比，鲤鱼不仅降低饲养成本，而且预计能提高饲喂效率，为鳜鱼幼鱼的大规模养殖提供有力支持。

statement_en: As the dietary carbohydrate-to-lipid ratio increased from 0.12 to 1.71, final body weight, weight gain rate, specific growth rate and protein efficiency ratio increased, then decreased with further increases in the ratio.
statement_zh: 随着日粮碳水化合物与脂质比例从0.12增加到1.71，终末体重、增重率、特定生长率和蛋白质效率比增加，随后随比例进一步增加而下降。

statement_en: In one study of Chinese perch (mandarin fish), the dietary carbohydrate-to-lipid ratio changed feed intake, which was significantly higher in group D3 than in D1, D2 and D4. It also changed appetite-gene expression: the appetite-inhibiting factor cart was higher in D1, and pomc was down-regulated in D2 and D3. The claims describe these appetite and intake changes and do not state whether they mean better or worse welfare.
statement_zh: 在一项鳜鱼研究中,日粮碳水化合物与脂质比例不同会影响摄食量:D3组摄食量显著高于D1、D2和D4组。食欲相关基因表达也有变化:抑制食欲因子cart在D1组显著升高,pomc在D2和D3组显著下调。这些结果只描述了摄食量和食欲基因的变化,并未说明对福利是好是坏。

practice_en: co-feeding fish mince and formulated feed
practice_zh: 碎鱼肉与配合饲料混合投喂
statement_en: In one study of hybrid mandarin fish, mixing minced fish with formulated feed was reported to raise appetite and improve digestion and growth. Early on (first 97 days), growth fell as the share of minced fish dropped, because minced fish was more palatable and digestible. By the end of the experiment, mixed diets with more formulated feed gave better growth, and appetite-related genes (leptin, ghrelin, NPY) changed with the mix ratio.
statement_zh: 在一项杂交鳜的研究中,碎鱼肉与配合饲料混合投喂可提高摄食欲、改善消化并促进生长。试验前97天,随着碎鱼肉比例下降,体重和生长率呈下降趋势,原因是碎鱼肉适口性和消化性更好;而到试验结束时,配合饲料比例较高的混合饲料生长表现反而更好。此外,瘦素、胃饥饿素和NPY等与食欲相关的基因表达也随混合比例发生变化。

statement_en: Similarly, replacing fishmeal with a mixed animal and plant protein source composed of shrimp hydrolysate and plant protein improved the growth performance of largemouth bass, and using the composite protein reduced the fishmeal content in the feed to 30%.
statement_zh: 同样，用虾水解物和植物蛋白混合物组成的混合动植物蛋白源替代鱼粉改善了大口黑鲈的生长性能，且使用复合蛋白将饲料中鱼粉含量降低至30%。

statement_en: The claims for mandarin fish are only background citations from studies on other species (Nile tilapia and carp), not mandarin fish data. In those species, adding multi-enzyme or compound enzyme products improved growth, feed efficiency, digestibility or digestive enzyme activity, though one tilapia study found a decrease in feed intake and a carp study reported increased feed intake.
statement_zh: 这几条证据都不是鲟鳜(鳜鱼)本身的数据,而是文中引用的罗非鱼和鲤鱼研究。在这些鱼类中,添加复合酶或混合酶总体改善了生长、饲料效率、消化率或肠道消化酶活性;但有一项罗非鱼研究显示采食量有所下降,而鲤鱼研究则报告采食量增加。

statement_en: In one study of mandarin fish, feeding compound Chinese herbal medicine at 1% and 2% improved growth performance and digestive capacity compared with the control group, and pepsin activity was significantly higher in both groups. The authors suggest the nutrients and bioactive components in the herbs may explain this.
statement_zh: 在一项关于鳜鱼的研究中,饲料中添加1%和2%的复方中草药,与对照组相比,生长性能和消化能力均明显提高,胃蛋白酶活性也显著升高。作者认为这可能与中草药含有多种营养成分和生物活性成分有关。

practice_zh: 棉籽蛋白浓缩物替代鱼粉
statement_en: Effects of replacing fishmeal with cottonseed protein concentrate on growth, intestinal microbiota, hematological and antioxidant indicators in juvenile Trachinotus ovatus.
statement_zh: 用棉籽蛋白浓缩物替代鱼粉对卵形鲳鲹幼鱼的生长、肠道菌群、血液学和抗氧化指标的影响。

statement_en: In contrast, the growth rate of fish fed diet 2 was higher than that of other treatment groups.
statement_zh: 相比之下，喂食日粮2的鱼的生长率高于其他处理组。

practice_en: diet with 55% crude protein and 14% crude lipid
statement_en: A recent feeding trial on juvenile mandarin fish weighing less than 9 g showed that a diet containing 55% crude protein and 14% crude lipid produced the best feed intake and growth performance.
statement_zh: 一项针对体重小于9克的鳜鱼幼鱼的近期饲养试验表明，含有55%粗蛋白和14%粗脂质的饲料产生了最佳的摄食和生长性能。

statement_en: In one 2024 study on mandarin fish (Chinese perch), antioxidant and gut health indicators put the optimal dietary arginine at 2.99%–3.37% of dry feed (6.08%–6.79% of dietary protein). Measured feed conversion ratio, feed intake and survival did not differ significantly among the groups, although survival was numerically highest (96.67%) at 3.37% arginine.
statement_zh: 一项2024年的研究显示，以抗氧化和肠道健康指标估算，鳜（Chinese perch）日粮中精氨酸的适宜水平约为干饲料的2.99%–3.37%（占日粮蛋白的6.08%–6.79%）。但各组之间的饵料系数、摄食量和成活率差异不显著，只是在精氨酸3.37%时成活率数值上最高（96.67%）。

statement_en: In mandarin fish fed high-fat or high-carbohydrate diets, dietary betaine (1% in the high-carbohydrate case) increased feed intake and appetite, with orexigenic hypothalamic genes (npy, agrp2) up and the anorexigenic gene cart down; one paper, however, reported no significant difference in feeding rates between groups.
statement_zh: 在饲喂高脂或高碳水日粮的鳜鱼中，日粮添加甜菜碱（高碳水日粮中为1%）可提高摄食量和食欲，下丘脑促食欲基因npy、agrp2表达上调，抑食欲基因cart表达下调；不过有一篇研究报告各组摄食率无显著差异。

statement_en: Basic research on juvenile Platycephalus indicus reared with different feeds.
statement_zh: 不同饲料养殖印度鲬幼鱼的基础研究。

statement_en: 현재 양식 현장에서는 쏘가리 치어의 배합사료 순치에 뱀장어 양성용 시판 분말사료가 주로 사용되고 있다.

In mandarin fish, one study screened five essential amino acids (leucine, valine, histidine, lysine and methionine) as having a persistent effect on feed intake, and reported lysine and methionine as likely feed-stimulating, in addition to valine. The claims do not give doses or conditions, and the rainbow trout finding is cited background, not a result in mandarin fish.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼中，一项研究筛选出亮氨酸、缬氨酸、组氨酸、赖氨酸和蛋氨酸这五种必需氨基酸对采食量有持续影响，并认为除缬氨酸外，赖氨酸和蛋氨酸也可能具有促进摄食的作用。这些结论中没有给出添加剂量或具体条件，虹鳟的结果只是引用的背景资料，并非鳜鱼本身的试验结果。

statement_en: At the end of the experiment, the higher hepatosomatic index (HSI) in the fasting group compared to the control group was due to excessive energy accumulation during the recovery process associated with feed re-supply.
statement_zh: 实验结束时，与对照组相比，禁食组较高的肝体指数（HSI）是由于在饲料重新供给相关的恢复过程中能量过度积累所致。

statement_en: The greatest growth performance and feed intake were observed in the L12 group.
statement_zh: 在L12组中观察到最大的生长性能和采食量。

statement_en: 사료의 조성과 형태를 조절하면 어류의 성장과 사료 효율을 개선할 수 있다.

practice_en: adjusting feed particle size by body weight
statement_en: Both claims only describe the practice of matching artificial feed particle size to fish size or growth stage; neither reports an effect on feeding-related welfare. One gives the sizes used (2.5 mm under 50 g, 3.5 mm under 120 g, 6.0 mm above 120 g), and the other states the adjustment in general terms.
statement_zh: 两条结论都只是描述了按鳜鱼体重或生长阶段调整人工饲料粒径的做法,并没有报告这种做法对摄食相关福利的影响。其中一条给出了所用粒径(体重50 g以下用2.5 mm,120 g以下用3.5 mm,120 g以上用6.0 mm),另一条只是笼统说明按生长阶段调整粒径。

statement_en: 사용 중인 사료의 품질을 개선하여 어류에 공급하는 것이 중요하다.
The amino acid composition of Artemia is unbalanced and its exoskeleton is rich in chitin, which reduces protein availability.
statement_zh: 卤虫氨基酸组成不均衡且外骨骼富含几丁质，降低了蛋白质的可利用性。

statement_en: Feed texture affected whether mandarin fish accepted and swallowed feed: in one measured test with equal nutritional composition, blind fish swallowed soft pellets but not paste-like balls, and the papers conclude that texture together with flavor determines swallowing. Two other claims are background statements that texture, along with size and shape, matters for acceptance of artificial feed (one concerns Atlantic salmon, not mandarin fish); none of the claims describes harm or benefit to welfare beyond feed acceptance.
statement_zh: 饲料质地会影响鳜是否接受并吞咽饲料:在营养成分相同的一项实测中,失明鳜吞咽软颗粒饲料,但不吞咽糊状饲料球,研究认为质地与风味共同决定吞咽行为。另有两条背景性说法指出质地(连同大小、形状)影响对人工饲料的接受度(其中一条针对大西洋鲑,并非鳜);这些结论均未涉及除摄食接受度以外的福利受益或损害。

statement_en: In one study on training mandarin fish to accept feed, feeding twice a day, which matches their natural twin-peak feeding rhythm, gave better acclimation than four times a day. At four feedings a day the domestication rate was significantly lower, aggressive acts increased, and appetite genes shifted toward less appetite (agrp down, pomc up). A different species (hybrid grouper) was reported to do best at four feedings a day, so the best frequency appears to depend on the species' natural feeding rhythm.
statement_zh: 在一项驯化鳜鱼摄食人工饲料的研究中，每天投喂2次符合其天然的双峰摄食节律，驯化效果优于每天4次。每天投喂4次时，驯化率显著降低，攻击行为增多，食欲基因也向食欲下降方向变化（agrp表达下降、pomc表达上升）。另有报道称杂交石斑鱼每天4次效果最好，说明适宜的投喂频率可能主要取决于鱼种自身的天然摄食节律。

statement_en: Most claims only describe how live bait fish are fed to mandarin fish (bait species such as carp or zebrafish fry, feeding frequency, bait size limited to within half the predator's body length) without reporting a welfare effect. The claims that do address outcomes say that suitable, palatable live feed at the start of feeding matters for survival, and that larvae given no palatable feed in the mixed feeding stage all die within 6 to 7 days.
statement_zh: 多数结论只是描述了鳜投喂活饵鱼的做法(如鲢鳙、鲤、鲂或斑马鱼苗做饵料,每天投喂次数,饵料鱼大小不超过鳜体长的一半),并未报告对福利的影响。涉及结果的结论认为,开口期及早提供适口的活饵对鳜苗成活率很关键,混合营养期如果没有适口饵料,鱼苗会在6~7天内全部死亡。

statement_en: Most of these claims only describe how mandarin fish were fed, such as individual housing with up to 3 bait fish daily, twice-daily feeding with bait fish at five times the juvenile density, mud carp at about 5% of biomass, and ensuring pellet feed was eaten. Two claims say that reasonable feeding management supports healthy growth, but none reports a measured welfare effect or the conditions behind it.
statement_zh: 这些研究大多只是描述鳜鱼的投喂做法,例如单缸饲养、每天最多投喂3尾饵料鱼,每天投喂两次且饵料鱼密度为鳜幼鱼的五倍,按总生物量约5%投喂鲜活泥鳅幼鱼,以及保证颗粒饲料被吃完。有两条结论认为合理的投喂管理有利于鳜鱼健康生长,但都没有给出实测的福利效果,也没有说明具体条件。

statement_en: The optimal feeding rate depends on multiple factors such as species, size, and farming conditions.
statement_zh: 最佳投喂率取决于物种、大小和养殖条件等多种因素。

statement_en: Both claims only describe feeding regimes used for mandarin fish, not effects on welfare: twice-daily feeding (morning and late afternoon) at about 3-5% of biomass in one paper (to apparent satiation) and 4.0-5.0% of body weight per day of fresh and frozen feed in the other. Neither claim reports a welfare outcome or compares feeding rates or frequencies.
statement_zh: 这两条结论都只是描述鳜鱼的投喂方式,没有报告对福利的影响:一篇按饱食投喂,每天上午、下午各一次,投喂量约为总体重的3-5%;另一篇每天投喂鲜料和冻料,占体重4.0-5.0%,分两次等量投喂。两条都没有给出福利结果,也没有比较不同的投喂率或投喂频率。

practice_zh: 摄食行为与感觉机理研究
statement_en: By studying feeding behavior and sensory mechanisms, the problem of mandarin fish actively consuming compound feed was solved.
statement_zh: 通过研究摄食行为和感觉机理，解决了鳜主动摄食配合饲料的问题。

statement_en: Feeding stimulants affect the growth performance, feed intake, and appetite regulation of mandarin fish.
statement_zh: 摄食刺激剂对鳜鱼的生长性能、采食量和食欲调节有影响。

statement_en: The results of this study indicate that hybrid mandarin fish easily consume frozen feed and artificial feed.
statement_zh: 本研究结果表明，鳜鱼杂交种容易摄食冷冻饲料和人工饲料。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, one paper reports mixed digestive results for frozen feed: lipase activity was higher than in the other two feeding groups, and hepatic lipase was significantly higher than with artificial feed but not significantly different from live bait. The same paper also notes that digestive capacity for frozen feed (and artificial feed) was reduced alongside tissue damage, so the evidence on feeding welfare is mixed.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼上,同一篇研究对冷冻饲料的消化指标结果不一:投喂冷冻饲料的鱼脂肪酶活性高于另外两个处理组,肝脏脂肪酶活性显著高于人工饲料组,但与活饵组差异不显著。该研究同时指出,除组织损伤外,鱼对冷冻饲料(及人工饲料)的消化能力也有所下降,因此对摄食方面福利的影响并不一致。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, the HB group feed showed mixed digestive enzyme results against the AB group: pepsin activity was higher in HB at 4 days of age, while trypsin activity was higher in AB at 6 days of age. The HB group also had intact intestinal villi with a large food contact area, whereas the AB group showed mucosal shedding, more goblet cells and sparse, ruptured villi.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼中，HB组饵料与AB组相比，消化酶结果不一：4日龄时HB组胃蛋白酶活性更高，6日龄时AB组胰蛋白酶活性更高。同时，HB组肠绒毛结构完整、与食物接触面积大，而AB组出现黏膜脱落、杯状细胞增多、绒毛稀疏断裂。

statement_en: This may be related to the fact that, under current farming conditions, all designed feed formulations can meet the growth requirements of farmed fish and that the experimental feeds have high palatability.
statement_zh: 这可能与在当前养殖条件下，所有设计的饲料配方都能满足养殖鱼类的生长需求以及实验饲料具有高适口性有关。

statement_en: Although daily feed intake (DFI) was not affected by dietary treatment, fish fed the 55% protein diet showed significantly higher daily protein intake (DPI) compared to those fed diets with 45% or lower protein.
statement_zh: 虽然每日摄食量（DFI）不受日粮处理的影响，但与喂食45%或更低蛋白日粮的鱼相比，喂食含55%蛋白日粮的鱼显示出显著更高的每日蛋白摄入量（DPI）。

statement_en: 이러한 결과는 쏘가리가 성장을 위해 사료에서 높은 수준의 단백질을 필요로 함을 나타낸다.
However, more suitable artificial feeds need to be developed for this species to improve its digestive function and the histological condition of the digestive tract.
statement_zh: 然而，需要为该物种开发更合适的人工饲料，以改善其消化功能和消化道的组织学状况。

statement_en: As the carbohydrate-to-lipid ratio in the feed increased, the feed intake of mandarin fish in the D3 group was significantly higher than that in other treatment groups.
statement_zh: 随着饲料中碳水化合物与脂质比例的升高，D3组鳜鱼的摄食量显著高于其他处理组。

statement_en: The claims mostly describe difficulty rather than benefit: mandarin fish are hard to train onto artificial feed, with uneven sizes and low survival reported, and fish that were difficult to domesticate showed higher expression of anorexia-related genes (mc4r, htr1b, lgr4) in the brain. Feed domestication also produced differences in body weight and length between groups, and one inferred claim says certain mechanisms help the fish adapt to artificial feed, but no conditions or measured welfare benefit are given.
statement_zh: 这些结论大多反映的是驯食困难而非益处:鳜属典型肉食性鱼类,投喂人工饲料驯化难度大,驯食过程中常出现个体大小不均、成活率低;驯化困难组的脑中厌食相关基因(mc4r、htr1b、lgr4)显著上调。驯化后不同组之间体重和体长也出现了差异。另有一条推断性结论认为某些机制有利于鳜适应人工饲料,但未给出具体条件,也没有实测的福利改善证据。

statement_en: Initial stocking density affects the acclimation to feeding and growth of juvenile yellowcheek fish.
statement_zh: 初始放养密度对黄颊鱼幼鱼的驯食和生长有影响。

statement_en: The control group was fed to satiation twice daily, while the other three groups were fasted for 5 days, 10 days, and 14 days respectively before resuming feeding to satiation.
statement_zh: 对照组每天两次饱食投喂，而其余三组分别禁食5天、10天和14天后恢复饱食投喂。

statement_en: Scientists found through quantitative feeding trials that L-glutamate can rapidly promote food consumption.
statement_zh: 科学家通过定量摄食试验发现L-谷氨酸能迅速促进食物消耗。

statement_en: Two supportive claims from one paper suggest that Lactococcus helped mandarin fish accept and eat formulated feed. One, reported as background, says it affects palatability, gut microbiota and intestinal microvilli, and so raises feed intake; the other is the authors' hypothesis that it indirectly aided digestion and absorption and thereby growth. Neither claim gives conditions or measured effects.
statement_zh: 同一篇论文的两条支持性结论认为,乳球菌有助于鳜鱼接受并摄食配合饲料。一条是背景性引述,称其可影响饲料适口性、肠道菌群和肠绒毛形态,从而提高摄食量;另一条是作者的推测,认为它间接促进了配合饲料的消化吸收,进而促进个体生长发育。两条结论均未给出具体条件或实测效果。

practice_en: diets with different lipid and carbohydrate levels
practice_zh: 不同脂质和碳水化合物水平日粮
statement_en: Different dietary lipid and carbohydrate levels had no significant effect on the survival rate, final body weight, specific growth rate, feed intake, feed efficiency, and protein efficiency of mandarin fish.
statement_zh: 不同的膳食脂质和碳水化合物水平对鳜鱼的存活率、终体重、特定生长率、摄食量、饲料效率和蛋白质效率没有显著影响。

practice_en: replacing live bait with artificial feed
statement_en: The results showed that complete replacement of live feed with formulated feed in European sea bass produced good development, growth and survival rates at a commercial scale.
statement_zh: 结果显示，在欧洲鲈鱼中完全用配合饲料替代活饵在商业规模上产生了良好的发育、生长和存活率。

practice_en: transition from live feed to formulated feed
statement_en: Significant phenotypic variation among individuals was observed during the domestication of S. chuatsi to formulated feed, despite overall successful domestication.
statement_zh: 在S. chuatsi驯化至配合饲料的过程中观察到个体间存在显著的表型变异，尽管整体驯化成功。

statement_en: This study established a link between systemic amino acid sensing and the control of feeding by amino acids, providing a theoretical basis for farming with low-fish-meal diets.
statement_zh: 该研究建立了系统性氨基酸感知与氨基酸对摄食控制之间的联系，为低鱼粉饲料养殖提供理论基础。

statement_en: The study found that fish were most attracted to moist particles with a length of 15 to 18 mm and a moisture content exceeding 30%.
statement_zh: 研究发现，鱼最被吸引的是长度在15到18毫米之间、含水量超过30%的湿润颗粒。

statement_en: Studies show that adding an appropriate amount of monosodium glutamate (MSG) to the diet may improve food intake.
statement_zh: 研究表明，在膳食中添加适量的味精（MSG）可能会改善食物摄入量。

practice_en: net cage farming with formulated feed
practice_zh: 网箱养殖与配合饲料投喂
statement_en: Fully domesticated mandarin fish fry were placed in net cages and fed formulated feed throughout the experiment.
statement_zh: 完全驯化的鳜鱼苗种被放置在网箱中，并在整个实验期间投喂配合饲料。

statement_en: In one 2023 study, mandarin fish fed non-living and artificial feeds gained 1.5–2.1 times less weight than controls fed live fish, and needed 1.5–2.7 times more feed per unit of gain, so feeding performance was worse on these feeds. The claims do not state the specific feed types or rearing conditions.
statement_zh: 2023年的一项研究显示,用非活饵和人工饲料投喂鳜鱼,其绝对增重比投喂活鱼的对照组低1.5–2.1倍,单位增重的饲料消耗则高出1.5–2.7倍,说明摄食和生长表现较差。这些结论中没有说明具体的饲料种类和养殖条件。

statement_en: To obtain the maximum specific growth rate (SGR), the determined optimal dietary carbohydrate level was 10.93%.
statement_zh: 为获得最大特定生长率（SGR），确定的最佳膳食碳水化合物水平为10.93%。

statement_en: In this study, compared to live bait fish feed, pellet feed altered the gut microbiota structure of mandarin fish, which may be mainly caused by changes in dietary composition and is also influenced by environmental stress (including dietary stress).
statement_zh: 在本研究中，与活饵鱼饲料相比，颗粒饲料改变了鳜鱼的肠道菌群结构，这可能主要由膳食结构变化引起，同时也受环境压力（包括饮食压力）的影响。

statement_en: The phosphorus/energy ratio in artificial feed regulates the growth performance, feed intake, feed utilization, and body composition of mandarin fish by affecting protein synthesis, energy homeostasis, enzyme activity, and serum biochemical indicators.
statement_zh: 人工饲料中的磷/能比通过影响蛋白质合成、能量稳态、酶活性和血清生化指标，进而调节鳜鱼的生长性能、摄食量、饲料利用率和体成分。

statement_en: The urgency of replacing fishmeal with plant protein in industrial applications has increased, but the key differences in essential amino acid content and ratios between the two are difficult to reconcile, which has prompted attention to the regulatory mechanisms of essential amino acids on feeding.
statement_zh: 工业应用中用植物蛋白替代鱼粉的紧迫性增加，但两者在必需氨基酸含量和比例上的关键差异难以调和，这促使重视必需氨基酸对摄食的调节机制。

statement_en: Different dietary protein-to-energy ratios affect feed intake and appetite regulation in gilthead seabream.
statement_zh: 不同的膳食蛋白质与能量比例会影响金头鲷的摄食量和食欲调节。

statement_en: Six soft pellet feeds with different protein gradients were prepared, and the experiment was conducted in 24 rearing units, each stocked with 30 experimental fish.
statement_zh: 研究制备了六个不同蛋白质梯度的软颗粒饲料，并在24个养殖单位中每单位饲养30尾实验鱼进行试验。

practice_en: high vs low protein diet comparison
statement_en: This means that fish fed a high-protein diet (45-55% dietary protein) utilize dietary protein more effectively than fish fed a low-protein diet (35%).
statement_zh: 这意味着喂食高蛋白日粮（45-55%膳食蛋白）的鱼比喂食低蛋白日粮（35%）的鱼更有效地利用膳食蛋白。

statement_en: The two claims only describe how mandarin fish were fed under quantitative feeding: broodstock kept in two standard cages on a rationed feeding regime, and fish fed at 1% of body weight at 9 a.m. Neither claim reports an effect on welfare.
statement_zh: 这两条结论都只是描述鳜鱼的定量投喂做法:亲鱼养在两个标准网箱中按定量方式投喂,另一条是每天上午9点按体重1%投喂。两条都没有报告对鱼类福利的影响。

statement_en: Similar results were also found in grass carp [44] and juvenile shrimp [45], which are consistent with other studies.
statement_zh: 在草鱼[44]和幼虾[45]中也发现了类似的结果，这些结果与其他研究一致。

statement_en: In natural water bodies, the availability and palatability of bait are crucial for the survival of juvenile Chinese perch; therefore, the type, density, and biomass of bait should be investigated to determine the release specifications for Chinese perch.
statement_zh: 在自然水体中，饵料的可用性和适口性对鳜鱼幼鱼的存活至关重要，因此应调查饵料的种类、密度和生物量以确定鳜鱼的放流规格。

statement_en: Common carp and rainbow trout fed to 80% and 75% satiation, respectively, showed no significant difference in weight gain (WG) and specific growth rate (SGR) compared to the same species fed to 100% satiation.
statement_zh: 鲤鱼和虹鳟在分别投喂至80%和75%饱食度时，其体重增长（WG）和特定生长率（SGR）与投喂至100%饱食度的同种鱼类相比无显著差异。

statement_en: In this study, we used a pond-based rice floating bed (PRFB) system to rear mandarin fish using artificial feed.
statement_zh: 在本研究中，我们利用基于池塘的水稻浮床（PRFBs）系统使用人工饲料养殖鳜鱼。

statement_en: Regularly changing feed can avoid nutritional imbalance or drug resistance issues.
statement_zh: 定期更换饲料可避免营养不均衡或抗药性问题。

statement_en: Artemia enriched with Schizochytrium has a certain potential for short-term replacement of natural feed during the initial feeding stage of Siniperca chuatsi.
statement_zh: 裂壶藻强化的卤虫在鳜初次摄食阶段具有一定的短期替代天然饵料的潜力。

statement_en: Из-за плохого подбора корма со дна, резаную рыбу вносили тремя порциями с интервалом 20–30 минут для обеспечения захвата в толще воды.

In one study of mandarin fish, researchers compared switching from live to dead baitfish with and without a dead-baitfish demonstrator, and reported that social learning promoted acquisition of the new feeding habit, with a significant effect on domestication and food intake. The other supporting claim is background on Atlantic salmon, not mandarin fish, and the claims give no specific conditions or figures.
statement_zh: 一项针对鳜鱼的研究比较了有无死饵鱼示范个体时,鳜从活饵转为摄食死饵的驯化情况,结果表明社会学习能促进鳜形成新的摄食习性,并对驯化和摄食量有显著影响。另一条支持性内容是关于大西洋鲑的背景报道,并非鳜鱼本身;这些结论中没有给出具体条件或数据。

statement_en: During feeding, mandarin fish feed on mullet, while mullet are fed commercial feed at 8 a.m.
statement_zh: 在投喂期间，鳜以莫氏鲻为食，而莫氏鲻在上午8点投喂商业饲料。

statement_en: Farms formulate scientific feed recipes based on growth stages and adopt a staged feeding strategy.
statement_zh: 养殖场根据生长阶段制定科学饲料配方并采用分段投喂策略。

statement_en: In juvenile mandarin fish, treatment with 20 mg/L trypsin inhibitor significantly reduced feeding rate, and it raised the appetite-suppressing factors CCK and POMC, while the appetite-stimulating factors NPY and AgRP showed no significant change. All four claims come from a single paper.
statement_zh: 在鳜幼鱼中，20 mg/L 胰蛋白酶抑制剂处理显著降低了摄食率，同时上调了抑制食欲的因子 CCK 和 POMC，而促进食欲的因子 NPY 和 AgRP 没有显著变化。这四条结论都来自同一篇论文。

statement_en: 평균 체중 114g의 어류 두 복귀 그룹에게 6가지 실험 사료 중 하나를 하루에 두 번씩 10주간 급여하였다.

In one study of mandarin fish, wet pellets and mince did not work well as feed: 26–30% of the wet pellets were left uneaten in the trial cages, and although the fish ate dead, cut-up fish, most did not switch to eating mince or wet pellets. Both claims come from the same paper and point to poor acceptance of this feed.
statement_zh: 在一项针对鳜鱼的研究中,湿颗粒饲料和鱼糜的效果不理想:试验网箱中有26–30%的湿颗粒饲料没有被吃掉;鱼虽然能摄食死鱼和切块鱼,但大多数没有转食鱼糜和湿颗粒饲料。两条结论都来自同一篇论文,说明这类饲料的摄食接受度较差。

statement_en: Due to the overstocking of Chinese mitten crabs in recent years, submerged plants, one of their most important food resources, have gradually decreased.
statement_zh: 由于过去几年中华绒螯蟹的过度放养，作为其最重要食物资源之一的沉水植物逐渐减少。

statement_en: After transport stress, the antioxidant enzyme activity of mandarin fish fed CF was inhibited compared to that of mandarin fish fed LF.
statement_zh: 运输刺激后，与饲喂LF的鳜相比，饲喂CF的鳜的抗氧化酶活性受到抑制。

statement_en: Both claims, from one 2025 paper, say that high-density farming of mandarin fish worsens water quality: ammonia-nitrogen fluctuates more and total ammonia-nitrogen often exceeds natural water levels because of metabolic waste, feed residues and microbial mineralization, so the fish face ammonia-nitrogen stress. The claims state no specific density or concentration, and no claim shows a neutral or positive effect.
statement_zh: 同一篇2025年论文的两条结论均指出,鳜鱼高密度养殖会使水质变差:代谢废物、残饵和微生物矿化的累积作用使氨氮波动加剧,总氨氮常常超过自然水体水平,鳜鱼因此面临氨氮胁迫。这些结论没有给出具体的养殖密度或氨氮浓度,也没有结论显示无影响或有益影响。

statement_en: The insights from this study will be used to improve low-temperature aquaculture feed for mandarin fish, aiming to reduce ammonia and nitrogen emissions, thereby advancing low-ammonia-emission aquaculture practices for this species.
statement_zh: 该研究的见解将用于改进鳜鱼低温养殖饲料，旨在减少氨和氮排放，从而推进该物种的低氨排放养殖实践。

statement_en: Aldehyde disinfectants have strong inactivation efficacy against MFBV, with glutaraldehyde being the most effective.
statement_zh: 醛类消毒剂对MFBV具有强灭活效力，其中戊二醛最有效。

practice_zh: 抗病毒技术/疫苗/药物开发
statement_en: Elucidating the infection and pathogenic mechanisms of fish rhabdoviruses is crucial for the construction of future antiviral technologies and the development of vaccines or antiviral drugs.
statement_zh: 揭示鱼类弹状病毒的感染和致病机制对于未来抗病毒技术的构建以及疫苗或抗病毒药物的开发至关重要。

statement_en: Unpublished data indicate that the attenuated live MRV vaccine (but not the inactivated MRV vaccine) provided effective protection against challenge with virulent MRV in a mandarin fish model.
statement_zh: 未发表的数据表明，减毒活MRV疫苗（而非灭活MRV疫苗）在鳜鱼模型中提供了针对强毒力MRV攻击的有效保护。

statement_en: Infections caused by bacteria such as Aeromonas hydrophila were excluded by species-specific PCR detection.
statement_zh: 通过物种特异性PCR检测排除了嗜水气单胞菌等细菌引起的感染。

statement_en: BPTES and EGCG inhibited ISKNV replication, indicating that they or their analogues may be promising compounds for preventing ISKNV infection.
statement_zh: BPTES和EGCG抑制了ISKNV的复制，表明它们或其类似物可能是预防ISKNV感染的有前景的化合物。

statement_en: C-I20 significantly reduced multi-type tissue damage.
statement_zh: C-I20显著减少了多类型组织损伤。

practice_zh: 载CiCXCL20a羧甲基壳聚糖纳米颗粒
statement_en: Carboxymethyl chitosan nanoparticles loaded with the bioactive protein CiCXCL20a can effectively prevent bacterial diseases in grass carp.
statement_zh: 负载生物活性蛋白CiCXCL20a的羧甲基壳聚糖纳米颗粒能有效预防草鱼细菌性疾病。

practice_en: copper sulfate and ferrous sulfate bath
statement_en: Disinfection treatment of mandarin fish fry during the rearing period using a mixture of copper sulfate and ferrous sulfate is effective.
statement_zh: 使用硫酸铜和硫酸亚铁混合剂对培育期间的鳜鱼苗进行消毒治疗效果较好。

statement_en: By alleviating oxidative stress and potentially limiting gill damage, this response helps protect the function of excretory organs.
statement_zh: 通过缓解氧化应激并潜在限制鳃损伤，这种反应有助于保护排泄器官的功能。

statement_en: The results showed that when cells were treated with DCA, both the intracellular ISKNV genome copy number and mature virus particles in the supernatant decreased at 36 and 48 hours post-infection, with the intracellular ISKNV genome copy number significantly decreasing by 57% at 48 hours.
statement_zh: 结果显示，当用DCA处理细胞时，在感染后36小时和48小时，细胞内ISKNV基因组拷贝数和上清液中成熟病毒颗粒均减少，其中48小时时细胞内ISKNV基因组拷贝数显著减少了57%。

statement_en: In the farming of economically valuable fish, disease monitoring becomes crucial because early detection of viral infections allows for rapid control measures.
statement_zh: 在经济价值鱼类的养殖中，疾病监测变得至关重要，因为早期检测病毒感染允许采取迅速的控制措施。

statement_en: Both claims, from a single 2025 paper, only describe testing how sensitive mandarin fish birnavirus (MFBV) is to various disinfectants, with the aim of reducing outbreaks; they give no results on fish welfare or disease levels, and no conditions or effect sizes.
statement_zh: 两条结论均出自同一篇2025年的论文,只是介绍了对鳜传染性脾肾坏死以外的鳜鱼双RNA病毒(MFBV)进行多种消毒剂敏感性测试,目的是减少疫病暴发;并未给出对鱼类福利或发病情况的实际效果,也没有说明具体条件或效果大小。

statement_en: A repeat experiment of DXMS treatment on 20隐性 MRV mandarin fish resulted in a cumulative mortality rate of 50% (10/20).
statement_zh: 对20只隐性MRV鳜鱼进行DXMS处理的重复实验导致累计死亡率为50%（10/20）。

statement_en: After immunizing Mandarin fish (Siniperca chuatsi) with the inactivated Flavobacterium columnare vaccine FKG4, the mRNA expression levels of the three regulatory subunits of NADPH oxidase (p40phox, p47phox, and p67phox) increased significantly in specific tissues.
statement_zh: 使用柱状黄杆菌灭活苗FKG4对翘嘴鳜进行免疫后，其NADPH氧化酶三个调节亚基（p40phox、p47phox、p67phox）在特定组织中的mRNA表达量显著上升。

practice_zh: 基于片段大小的病原鉴定
statement_en: Pathogens are identified by the specific DNA fragment sizes appearing after enzymatic digestion (182/171/163 bp corresponding to Aeromonas hydrophila, 136/117/96 bp corresponding to ISKNV, and the coexistence of all six corresponding to mixed infection).
statement_zh: 通过酶切后出现的特定DNA片段大小（182/171/163 bp对应嗜水气单胞菌，136/117/96 bp对应ISKNV，六者共存对应混合感染）来鉴定病原体。

statement_en: Previous research results indicate that the G protein DNA vaccine can provide higher immune protection against SCRV disease.
statement_zh: 先前的研究结果表明，G蛋白DNA疫苗可以对SCRV疾病产生更高的免疫保护。

statement_en: Hepcidin treatment significantly increased the survival rate of grass carp infected with Flavobacterium columnare and T. fasciatus infected with Vibrio anguillarum.
statement_zh: 铁调素处理可显著提高感染柱状黄杆菌的草鱼和感染鳗弧菌的T. fasciatus的存活率。

statement_en: However, when the intensity of methyltestosterone treatment was too high, the survival rate of the treated group was significantly lower than that of the control group.
statement_zh: 然而，当甲基睾酮的处理强度过高时，处理组的存活率显著低于对照组。

statement_en: The claims are mostly background and descriptive: raised superoxide anion production after immunostimulant exposure is described as beneficial against pathogens (reported for shrimp), and O2- production is described as a measure of immunostimulant efficacy. For mandarin fish, one claim says fish in Taoyuan Reservoir had higher SOD activity than those in two other sites after exposure to immunostimulants, which was considered beneficial; none of the claims directly report disease or parasite outcomes.
statement_zh: 这几条结论大多是背景性或描述性的：有报道称虾类接触免疫刺激剂后超氧阴离子产生增加，对抵御病原有益，O2-产生量也被用来衡量免疫刺激剂的效果。对鳜鱼而言，只有一条结论提到，接触免疫刺激剂后桃源水库的鳜SOD活性高于另外两个地点（灵津滩、五强溪），被认为有益；但没有任何一条直接报告疾病或寄生虫方面的结果。

statement_en: The two claims, both from one 2023 paper, only describe the practice and do not report a measured welfare effect in mandarin fish. They say inactivated vaccines against RSIV-I, ISKNV-I and RSIV-II have been developed using MFF-1 or grouper fin cell lines, and speculate that inactivated vaccines may be a promising solution to disease.
statement_zh: 这两条结论都出自同一篇2023年的论文,只是介绍了这项措施,并没有报告对鳜鱼福利的实测效果。文中说已经用MFF-1或石斑鱼鳍细胞系研制出针对RSIV-I、ISKNV-I和RSIV-II的灭活疫苗,并推测灭活疫苗可能是解决疾病问题的一个有前景的办法。

practice_en: inactivated vaccine or non-lethal live virus exposure
practice_zh: 灭活疫苗或非致死活病毒暴露
statement_en: Therefore, both inactivated vaccines and non-lethal live virus exposure can elicit strong immune protection against virulent ISKNV/RSIV infection or reinfection.
statement_zh: 因此，无论是灭活疫苗还是非致死性活性病毒暴露都能引发对强毒力ISKNV/RSIV感染或再感染的强大免疫保护。

statement_en: This study revealed the different gut microbiota adaptive responses of mandarin fish to feed and aquaculture environments, providing microbiological theoretical support for optimizing healthy aquaculture management of mandarin fish.
statement_zh: 本研究揭示了鳜鱼对饲料和水产养殖环境不同的肠道微生物适应性反应，为优化鳜鱼健康养殖管理提供了微生态学理论支持。

statement_en: Claims from two papers consistently report that inactivated ISKNV vaccines protect against ISKNV disease in mandarin fish: a licensed vaccine with a 90% absolute protection rate, a chitosan-adjuvanted version with significant protection, and a bivalent ISKNV-SCRV vaccine with protection above 90% for ISKNV and above 80% for SCRV. Most of these are background statements from the papers rather than new tests, and the claims give no test conditions; similar efficacy was also reported in Asian sea bass and spotted sea bass.
statement_zh: 两篇文献的说法一致，认为灭活ISKNV疫苗对鳜的ISKNV病有保护作用：已获批商用的疫苗绝对保护率为90%，壳聚糖佐剂疫苗保护效果显著，ISKNV-SCRV二联灭活疫苗对ISKNV保护率超过90%、对SCRV超过80%。不过这些大多是文献中的背景性介绍，并非新的试验，相关说法也没有给出具体试验条件；此外还提到该疫苗对大口黑鲈和花鲈同样有较高效力。

practice_zh: 细菌分离鉴定与16S rDNA PCR
statement_en: Bacteria were isolated and purified from multiple tissues of diseased mandarin fish, and identified using 16S rDNA PCR amplification technology.
statement_zh: 通过从患病鳜多组织取样、细菌培养分离纯化，并结合16S rDNA PCR扩增技术进行细菌学鉴定。

statement_en: Soaking fish fry with lipopolysaccharide can provide a certain degree of immune protection.
statement_zh: 使用脂多糖浸泡鱼苗可获得一定程度的免疫保护力。

statement_en: The method for preventing and controlling water mold disease is to use 1 ppm malachite green for disinfection daily for 10 days, by closing the inlet valve, adding the medicinal solution, stirring, and then slowly diluting and draining it out.
statement_zh: 防治水霉病的方法是每天使用1ppm孔雀石绿消毒，持续10天，通过关闭进水阀加入药液搅拌后缓慢稀释流出的方式操作。

statement_en: In one 2011 study, mSDP treatment at 5, 10, 20 and 30 μM reduced ISKNV viral infection by 75%, 90%, 95% and 98% compared with untreated controls, with infection measured as the percentage of positive cells. The other claim only describes how infection was quantified.
statement_zh: 2011年的一项研究中,用5、10、20和30 μM的mSDP处理,与未处理对照组相比,可使ISKNV病毒感染分别降低75%、90%、95%和98%,感染程度以阳性细胞百分比计算。另一条结论只是说明了感染的统计方法。

statement_en: Zhang et al. [7] reported a cloned sea bass rhabdovirus Sanxi-7 (MSRV-SS-7) strain as a potential live vaccine candidate against SCRV disease.
statement_zh: Zhang等人[7]报道了一种克隆鲈鱼弹状病毒三水-7（MSRV-SS-7）株，作为对抗SCRV疾病的潜在活疫苗候选物。

practice_zh: 寄生虫检查与细菌分离鉴定
statement_en: Through microscopic examination and bacterial isolation and identification, no parasites or dominant pathogenic bacteria were found, thereby ruling out the possibility of parasitic disease and bacterial disease.
statement_zh: 通过显微镜检查和细菌分离鉴定，未发现寄生虫或优势致病菌，从而排除了寄生虫病和细菌病的可能性。

statement_en: Before the experiment, random sampling testing by qPCR confirmed that mandarin fish had no asymptomatic MRV carriers.
statement_zh: 实验前通过qPCR随机抽样检测，确认鳜鱼无无症状MRV携带者。

practice_zh: 入池前健康检查与筛选
statement_en: Before being placed into the tank, the fish underwent a thorough injury and disease check, and healthy individuals of uniform size were selected.
statement_zh: 在放入水箱之前，对鱼进行了彻底的伤病检查，并选择了大小均匀的健康个体。

statement_en: One 2025 paper claims that drug use in mandarin fish should follow a prevention-first principle, and that preventive medication in the high-incidence season can reduce pathogen numbers and infection risk. These are supportive claims only; no measured welfare outcomes or doses are given.
statement_zh: 一篇2025年的论文提出，鳜鱼用药应遵循“预防为主”的原则，并认为在发病高发季节进行预防性用药可以减少病原数量、降低感染风险。这些只是支持性的说法，没有给出具体的福利效果数据或用药剂量。

statement_en: Therefore, developing new and rapid virus detection technologies is crucial for the prevention and control of MRV and ISKNV diseases.
statement_zh: 因此，开发新型、快速的病毒检测技术对于预防和控制MRV和ISKNV疾病至关重要。

statement_en: In addition, reasonable, scientific and standardized drug use should be carried out to control and reduce [antibiotic resistance/disease].
statement_zh: 此外，应进行合理、科学和规范的药物使用，以控制和减少[耐药性/疾病]。

statement_en: In one 2012 paper, the siRNA si983, which targets the N gene, reduced viral titer more than the other siRNAs tested and the control, and it was inferred to lower SCRV transmission and delay cytopathic effects. The claims give no conditions and report no disease or welfare outcomes in live fish.
statement_zh: 一篇2012年的研究显示,靶向N基因的si983在所测试的siRNA中降低病毒滴度的效果最好,优于对照组,并据此推断它能明显抑制SCRV传播、延缓细胞病变出现。这些结论没有给出具体条件,也没有报告活体鳜的发病或福利方面的结果。

statement_en: These results indicate that ScHSP60 stimulates an immune response to protect fish from damage caused by Aeromonas hydrophila.
statement_zh: 这些结果表明，ScHSP60刺激免疫反应以保护鱼类免受嗜水气单胞菌造成的损害。

statement_en: Controlling secondary bacterial infections may be an effective strategy to reduce the overall mortality of hemorrhagic diseases in aquaculture.
statement_zh: 控制继发性细菌感染可能是降低水产养殖中出血性疾病总体死亡率的有效策略。

statement_en: Virus testing of seedlings before introduction to exclude pathogens.
statement_zh: 引进前对苗种进行病毒检测以排除病原体。

statement_en: In one 2025 paper on mandarin fish, seedling disease prevention and control was reported to raise survival to over 90% and to give seedlings stronger disease resistance and growth potential. The claims give no further conditions and show no disagreement or null results.
statement_zh: 一篇2025年的鳜鱼研究报道,苗种防控技术使苗种成活率提高到90%以上,并使苗种的抗病力和生长潜力更强。这些结论没有说明其他具体条件,也没有出现不一致或无效应的结果。

statement_en: When selecting seedlings, observe that the body surface is free of damage and that swimming activity is lively; avoid inbreeding or toxic seedlings.
statement_zh: 选苗时应观察体表无损伤和游动活泼度，避免近亲繁殖或带毒苗种。

statement_en: Parasite detection was performed on the gill filaments, fin rays, and other parts of diseased mandarin fish using the water immersion smear microscopic examination method.
statement_zh: 采用水浸片显微镜检测方法对患病鳜的鳃丝和鳍条等部位进行寄生虫检测。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, susceptibility testing of the bacterial strains isolated in two papers showed sensitivity to several drug classes (nine antibiotics in one study, including enrofloxacin, doxycycline, florfenicol and sulfamethoxazole; 14 of 30 drugs in the other), alongside resistance to others (cefuroxime, polymyxin B, amoxicillin and carbenicillin in one; 16 of 30 drugs including penicillin and ampicillin in the other). The claims only report in-vitro drug sensitivity and resistance of the strains, not any effect on fish health or disease outcomes, and the two papers differ on some drugs, for example polymyxin B and carbenicillin.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼上，两篇论文对分离到的病原菌做了药敏试验：一篇显示对9种抗菌药敏感（包括恩诺沙星、多西环素、氟苯尼考和磺胺甲噁唑），另一篇30种药物中对14种敏感；同时也有耐药，一篇对头孢呋辛、多粘菌素B、阿莫西林和羧苄西林耐药，另一篇对包括青霉素、氨苄西林在内的16种药物耐药。这些结果只是体外药物敏感与耐药情况，并未报告对鱼体健康或发病结局的影响，而且两篇在个别药物上结果不一致，例如多粘菌素B和羧苄西林。

practice_en: temperature stress, vaccination and dxms treatment
statement_en: After qPCR confirmed that surviving fish had entered a persistent infection state, vaccination and DXMS treatment were performed.
statement_zh: 通过qPCR确认幸存鱼进入持续感染状态后，进行了疫苗接种和DXMS处理。

statement_en: Both claims describe vaccination as an effective way to control disease in mandarin fish, one for bacterial infections (with vaccines against N. seriolae still being developed) and one for viral diseases. These are general statements, one of them background, and neither gives data on welfare outcomes or the conditions under which vaccination works.
statement_zh: 两条论述都认为疫苗接种是控制鳜病害的有效手段,一条针对细菌感染(针对诺卡氏菌N. seriolae的疫苗仍在研发中),另一条针对病毒性疾病。这些都是一般性的说法,其中一条还是背景性介绍,均未给出具体的福利效果数据,也没有说明在什么条件下有效。

statement_en: The two claims only describe how vaccines were prepared for mandarin fish: one used the MRV-ZQ17 isolate, and the other made a Flavobacterium columnare vaccine by shake culture, centrifugal washing and formalin inactivation. Neither claim reports an effect on disease or welfare.
statement_zh: 这两条结论只是描述了鳜鱼疫苗的制备方法:一条使用MRV-ZQ17毒株制备疫苗,另一条通过摇床培养、离心洗涤和福尔马林灭活制备柱状黄杆菌疫苗。两条都没有报告对疾病或福利的影响。

statement_en: Compared to the DMSO control group, treatment with VH298 and VH032 significantly reduced viral mRNA levels and viral genome copy numbers.
statement_zh: 与DMSO对照组相比，使用VH298和VH032处理后，病毒mRNA水平和病毒基因组拷贝数显著降低。

statement_en: Both claims only describe MS-222 being used to anesthetize mandarin fish before procedures (vaccine or control injection, and biometrics before tank allocation); neither reports an effect on welfare during handling or transport.
statement_zh: 这两条结果都只是描述在操作前用MS-222对鳜鱼进行麻醉(一条是注射疫苗或PBS对照,另一条是测量生物学指标后分配到养殖桶),均未报告其对操作或运输过程中鱼类福利的影响。

statement_en: In addition, the relationship between environmental microbial communities and gut microbiota was studied using 16S rRNA sequencing technology to reveal the relationship between fish diseases based on different water temperatures and photoperiods and environmental microbes.
statement_zh: 此外，利用16S rRNA测序技术研究了环境微生物群落与肠道菌群之间的关系，以揭示基于不同水温和光周期的鱼类疾病与环境微生物之间的关系。

statement_en: There was no cross-reactivity with other pathogens, and the Aeromonas hydrophila LAMP products yielded 182 bp, 171 bp, and 163 bp fragments after enzymatic digestion, while the ISKNV LAMP products yielded 136 bp, 117 bp, and 96 bp fragments after enzymatic digestion.
statement_zh: 与其他病原体无交叉反应，且嗜水气单胞菌LAMP产物酶切后出现182 bp、171 bp和163 bp片段，ISKNV LAMP产物酶切后出现136 bp、117 bp和96 bp片段。

statement_en: Daily monitoring records clinical signs and mortality events; pathogen recovery is performed on moribund samples.
statement_zh: 每日监测记录临床症状和死亡事件，濒死样本进行病原体回收。

statement_en: Dead fish were recorded daily, and the total mortality rate was calculated using the formula: Mortality (%) = 100 × Number of dead fish / Number of challenged fish.
statement_zh: 每天记录死亡鱼类，并按公式计算总死亡率：死亡率(%) = 100 × 死亡鱼数 / 接种鱼数。

statement_en: This enables on-site detection, which helps in timely diagnosis and implementation of appropriate control measures.
statement_zh: 这实现了现场检测，有助于及时诊断和实施适当的控制措施。

statement_en: The four claims mostly describe qPCR as a detection tool rather than showing a welfare effect: it picked up very small amounts of viral DNA in the spleen, liver and kidney during chronic infection that conventional PCR missed, and it was used to measure innate immune, intestinal fatty acid synthesis, tight junction and pro-inflammatory cytokine gene expression. In one study, RT-qPCR found MFBV in organ homogenates of dead fish but not in control fish.
statement_zh: 这四条结论主要是把荧光定量PCR作为检测手段来描述，并未显示对福利的影响：慢性感染期间，它能在脾、肝、肾中检出常规PCR检不到的微量病毒基因组DNA，也被用来测定先天免疫、肠道脂肪酸合成、紧密连接和促炎因子相关基因的表达。其中一项研究用RT-qPCR在死亡鳜的内脏匀浆中检出MFBV，而对照组鱼为阴性。

statement_en: Therefore, real-time monitoring of antimicrobial resistance and its trends in bacteria isolated from fish farming sites should be conducted regularly.
statement_zh: 因此，应定期对鱼类养殖场所分离出的细菌进行耐药性及其变化趋势的实时监测。

statement_en: In this study, we re-examined the histopathological changes in the pyloric caeca of Siniperca chuatsi following acute MRV infection and applied scRNA-seq to elucidate the transcriptional landscape of infected and uninfected pyloric caeca cells.
statement_zh: 在本研究中，我们重新审视了急性MRV感染后鳜鱼幽门盲囊的组织病理学变化，并应用scRNA-seq来阐明感染和未感染的幽门盲囊细胞的转录景观。

statement_en: PCR detection using primers for frog virus from largemouth bass showed that the virus infecting diseased mandarin fish had 100% sequence similarity to the isolate from largemouth bass, suggesting that the virus may have originated from largemouth bass.
statement_zh: 使用大口黑鲈源蛙病毒引物进行PCR检测，结果显示患病鳜感染的病毒与大口黑鲈分离株序列相似性100%，推测病毒可能来源于大口黑鲈。

statement_en: There is a behavioural method available to test feeding responses of fish to pelleted diets.

practice_en: feed intake assessment by quantity difference
practice_zh: 基于数量差的摄食量评估
statement_en: Both claims only describe how feed intake was measured in mandarin fish: by the difference between the initial and remaining number of feeder fish (C1688), or between the weight of feed added and uneaten feed siphoned out (C2445). Neither reports an effect on welfare, so no welfare outcome or conditions can be drawn from them.
statement_zh: 这两条结论只是说明鳜鱼摄食量是怎么测定的:一是用饵料鱼的初始尾数减去剩余尾数(C1688),二是用投喂饲料重量减去虹吸清出的残饵重量(C2445)。两者都没有报告对福利的影响,所以无法得出福利方面的结果或条件。

statement_en: Although the monoculture model of Elopichthys bambusa can increase yield per unit area, there are difficulties in controlling the timing, quantity, and size specifications of bait fish input.
statement_zh: 鳡鱼单养模式虽然能提高单位面积产量，但在饵料鱼投放的时间、数量和规格控制上存在困难。

statement_en: In most animals, lipid storage represents readily mobilizable energy reserves, while lean body mass contains structural tissues; therefore, the lipid/LBM ratio can be considered an indicator of nutritional status.
statement_zh: 在大多数动物中，脂质储存代表易激活的能量储备，而瘦体重包含结构组织，因此脂质/LBM比值可被视为营养状态的指标。

statement_en: Uneaten feed was collected by siphoning 15 minutes after feeding and dried at 60°C to calculate feed intake.
statement_zh: 饲喂15分钟后通过虹吸收集未食用的饲料，并在60°C下烘干以计算采食量。

statement_en: During the training period, fish were visually classified into feeders and non-feeders based on their body condition (plumpness or thinness).
statement_zh: 在训练期间，根据鱼体的丰满或消瘦程度，通过视觉将鱼分为摄食者和非摄食者。

statement_en: Before infection, individuals of the second group of mandarin fish were tagged by injecting microchips into the dorsal muscle.
statement_zh: 在感染前，通过向背部肌肉注射微芯片对第二组的鳜鱼个体进行标记。

statement_en: The system automatically alarms and notifies personnel to handle water quality abnormalities.
statement_zh: 系统自动报警并通知人员处理水质异常。

statement_en: After anesthesia, blood samples were collected from live fish via the caudal vein.
statement_zh: 在麻醉后，通过尾静脉从存活的鱼中采集血液样本。

practice_zh: 二氧化碳加氧气麻醉运输
statement_en: Chen et al. found that a transport method using carbon dioxide plus oxygen anesthesia could extend the survival time of mandarin fish to 23 hours.
statement_zh: Chen等人发现使用二氧化碳加氧气麻醉的运输方法可以将鳜鱼的存活时间延长至23小时。

statement_en: All the above-mentioned experimental fish were anesthetized with tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222, 100 mg/L) and euthanized by decapitation for subsequent sampling.
statement_zh: 所有上述实验鱼均用三卡甲磺酸酯（MS-222，100 mg/L）麻醉，并通过断头处死以进行后续采样。

statement_en: The claims only describe MS-222 being used to anesthetize mandarin fish for weighing, measuring, blood draws and tissue sampling, at concentrations ranging from about 20 to 200 mg/L (one paper gives 0.1 ppm). None of them measure its effect on handling or transport welfare, and the few supportive ones only say anesthesia was used to reduce suffering or stress during sampling.
statement_zh: 这些研究只是描述在称重、测量体长、采血和取样时用MS-222麻醉鳜鱼，浓度大致在20至200 mg/L之间（有一篇写的是0.1 ppm）。没有一条研究实际测定麻醉对操作或运输福利的影响，少数偏支持的说法也只是称麻醉用于取样时减轻痛苦或应激。

statement_en: The experimental fish were anesthetized and euthanized using MS-222 (200 mg/L).
statement_zh: 实验鱼使用MS-222（200 mg/L）麻醉并实施安乐死。

statement_en: The three claims only describe how mandarin fish were killed by physical stunning, with a forceful blow to the head using a blunt instrument or wooden hammer, in one case followed by immediate bleeding. They do not report any measured effect on welfare during handling and transport; one paper labels the method humane and another cites World Organisation for Animal Health recommendations.
statement_zh: 这三条结论只是描述了鳜鱼的物理击晕屠宰做法:用钝器或木锤猛击头部,其中一项研究在击晕后立即放血。它们没有报告该做法对捕捞、运输过程中福利的实际影响;一篇文献称其为人道处死,另一篇则提到参照了世界动物卫生组织的建议。

statement_en: Fish meeting the above standards are euthanized by immersion in ice water for at least 10 minutes.
statement_zh: 符合上述标准的鱼类通过浸入冰水中至少10分钟进行安乐死。

statement_en: Dissolved oxygen levels were regulated by aerating the water with air, pure oxygen, or nitrogen; 15 fish were kept in a 240-liter cylindrical tank, corresponding to a stocking density of about 3.6 kg/m³.
statement_zh: 通过向水中曝气空气、纯氧或氮气来调节溶解氧水平，240升圆柱形水箱中装有15条鱼，对应约3.6 kg/m³的放养密度。

statement_en: 용존 산소 공급을 위해 에어스톤이 사용되었다.

statement_zh: 苯扎溴铵在600 ppm时使病毒滴度降低4个对数单位，6000 ppm时降低7个对数单位，60,000 ppm时降低8个对数单位。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, the claims mostly describe how biofloc technology changed gut and water bacterial communities compared with the RS group, and none report disease or parasite outcomes directly. Richness and diversity were comparable between groups, and the gut showed mixed shifts (Actinobacteria higher in BF, Proteobacteria slightly higher in RS). One claim says the technology promotes beneficial bacteria and eradicates harmful ones, but the measured results do not show this.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼上，这些结论大多只是描述生物絮团技术（BF组）与RS组相比肠道和水体细菌群落的变化，没有直接报告疾病或寄生虫方面的结果。两组细菌群落的丰富度和多样性相当，肠道菌群变化不一：BF组放线菌明显更高，RS组变形菌门略高。有一条结论称该技术能促进有益菌生长并清除有害菌，但实测结果并未证实这一点。

statement_en: The claims only describe continuous aeration being used in mandarin fish tanks to keep dissolved oxygen sufficient, with two giving a range of 7.0–9.3 mg/L; one notes that morbidity and mortality were recorded over 7 days. None of them reports an effect of aeration on disease or parasites.
statement_zh: 这些研究只是描述了曼氏鳜（桂花鱼）养殖中采用连续充氧曝气来保证水体溶解氧充足，其中两项给出溶氧维持在7.0–9.3 mg/L；有一项记录了7天内的发病率和死亡率。但都没有报告曝气对疾病或寄生虫的具体影响。

statement_en: In flow-through incubation tanks, the drug application requires stopping the water flow for 30 minutes at a concentration of 1.4 ppm, whereas in static pools the concentration is 0.7 ppm.
statement_zh: 在流水式孵化缸中施药需停止流水30分钟且浓度为1.4ppm，而在静水池中浓度为0.7ppm。

statement_en: In one study of mandarin fish, hyperoxia raised plasma cortisol and, with hypoxia, caused liver tissue changes such as vacuolization, which points to stress and some cellular damage. Antioxidant responses were mixed: some enzymes and genes rose, but nrf2, gpx and liver MDA did not differ, so no lipid peroxidation was seen. None of the claims measured disease or parasites directly.
statement_zh: 在一项针对鳜的研究中，高氧暴露使血浆皮质醇升高，并与低氧一样导致肝组织出现空泡化等变化，提示存在应激和一定程度的细胞损伤。抗氧化反应结果不一：部分酶和基因上调，但nrf2、gpx表达和肝脏MDA含量无显著差异，未见明显脂质过氧化。这些结论均未直接测定疾病或寄生虫方面的指标。

statement_en: No mortality was observed in any treatment group during the 48-hour exposure period.
statement_zh: 在48小时的暴露期间，所有处理组均未观察到死亡。

statement_en: The two claims are supportive but come from different settings. One paper reports that hatching tanks were disinfected with 20 mg/L potassium permanganate before use, which describes the practice and gives no welfare outcome. The other reports that potassium permanganate lowered virus titre by 5 log units at 2000 ppm and by 8 log units at 20,000 ppm, which is a reduction in virus load and not a measure of disease in the fish.
statement_zh: 两项结论都是支持性的，但情形不同。一篇只说明孵化池使用前用20 mg/L高锰酸钾溶液消毒，属于做法描述，没有给出福利结果。另一篇显示高锰酸钾在2000 ppm时使病毒滴度降低5个对数单位，在20,000 ppm时降低8个对数单位，这反映的是病毒载量下降，而不是鱼发病情况的改善。

practice_en: lethal do by sealed respiration chamber
practice_zh: 密封呼吸室测致死溶氧
statement_en: After measuring oxygen consumption, the water flow was stopped and the test fish were retained in a sealed respiration chamber.
statement_zh: 在耗氧量测量后，关闭水流并将测试鱼保留在密封呼吸室中。

statement_en: Few of these claims address disease or parasites directly. One background claim (C1791) says earlier work found that hypoxia can promote ISKNV replication in mandarin fish and may be linked to viral outbreaks. The other claims describe physiological stress under hypoxia: ammonia and urea accumulated, oxidative stress and gill changes reduced ammonia excretion, and antioxidant genes were upregulated. Plasma ammonia was higher at 24 hours but lower at 48 hours, and none of these claims measured infection.
statement_zh: 这些研究结果里直接涉及疾病或寄生虫的很少。只有一条背景性说法(C1791)提到,以往研究发现低氧可促进鳜传染性脾肾坏死病毒(ISKNV)复制,可能与病毒病暴发有关。其余结果主要是低氧下的生理应激:氨和尿素蓄积,氧化应激和鳃结构变化使排氨率下降,抗氧化相关基因表达上调;血浆氨在24小时升高、48小时反而降低。这些结果都没有直接测定感染情况。

statement_en: The ALT, ALP, and AST activities in the 80 mg/Kg, 40 mg/Kg, and control groups were significantly higher than those in the other groups.
statement_zh: 80 mg/Kg、40 mg/Kg和对照组的ALT、ALP和AST活性显著高于其他组。

statement_en: Compared to the 28°C group, the ACE and Chao1 indices were significantly higher in the 18°C group.
statement_zh: 与28°C组相比，18°C组的ACE和Chao1指数显著更高。

statement_en: Hatching water is filtered through a 60-mesh screen to maintain freshwater quality and prevent harmful organisms from entering.
statement_zh: 孵化用水经过60目筛网过滤，以维持淡水水质并防止有害生物进入。

statement_en: In this environment, the diversity and structure of microbial communities significantly affect water quality and fish health, including functional bacteria, probiotics, and pathogens.
statement_zh: 在该环境中，微生物群落的多样性和结构显著影响水质和鱼类健康，包括功能细菌、益生菌和病原体。

statement_en: Iodophor, formaldehyde, sodium hypochlorite, hydrogen peroxide, and potassium permanganate require concentrations in the range of 10^3 ppm to achieve similar efficacy.
statement_zh: 而碘伏、甲醛、次氯酸钠、过氧化氢和高锰酸钾需要10^3 ppm范围内的浓度才能实现类似的效力。

statement_en: Dissolved oxygen levels were maintained at 0.9±0.1 mg/L by controlling the inflow of water and nitrogen gas.
statement_zh: 通过控制水和氮气的流入来维持0.9±0.1 mg/L的溶解氧水平。

statement_en: Oxygen supplementation is commonly used in modern intensive aquaculture to prevent hypoxia.
statement_zh: 补充氧气常用于现代集约化水产养殖以防止缺氧。

statement_en: Disinfection with quicklime or chlorine dioxide during pond clearing can kill potential pathogens.
statement_zh: 清塘时使用生石灰或二氧化氯进行消毒处理，可杀灭潜在病原体。

statement_en: Two claims support povidone-iodine against disease in mandarin fish. In one, 30 mg/L povidone-iodine was added to tanks 5 hours after hatching; the claim as given describes the treatment and does not report a welfare outcome. In the other, iodophor lowered virus titre by 4 log units at 2000 ppm and by 8 log units at 20,000 ppm.
statement_zh: 两项研究结果均支持聚维酮碘用于鳜病害防控。其一是在孵化后5小时向养殖水体中加入30 mg/L聚维酮碘，该结论只描述了处理方法，未给出福利方面的具体结果；其二是碘伏在2000 ppm时使病毒滴度降低4个对数单位，在20,000 ppm时降低8个对数单位。

statement_en: In mandarin fish culture, claims from one 2025 paper say that adding probiotic preparations such as Bacillus and Lactobacillus to the water helps regulate water quality, reduce or inhibit harmful bacteria, and enhance immunity, all supportive but without stated disease or parasite outcomes. A 2021 paper only describes adding Lactobacillus plantarum or Clostridium butyricum to the water at 1×10^8 CFU/mL during partial water replacement, without reporting an effect on disease.
statement_zh: 就鳜鱼养殖而言，2025年一篇论文称，水体中添加芽孢杆菌、乳酸菌等益生菌制剂，有助于调节水质、减少或抑制有害菌并增强免疫力，结论偏正面，但没有给出具体的发病或寄生虫结果。2021年另一篇论文只是描述了在部分换水时向水体中添加植物乳杆菌或丁酸梭菌，浓度维持在1×10^8 CFU/mL，没有报告对疾病的影响。

statement_en: Micropterus salmoides rhabdovirus can be inactivated within 30 minutes by 500 ppm povidone-iodine and 500 ppm glutaraldehyde.
statement_zh: 大口黑鲈弹状病毒可以通过500 ppm聚维酮碘和500 ppm戊二醛在30分钟内灭活。

practice_zh: 工厂化循环水养殖系统
statement_en: In mandarin fish, RAS rearing was associated with gut microbiota shifts, measured against pond (TPAS) rearing: fewer potential pathogenic genera (Mycobacterium, Clostridium, Staphylococcus), lower Aeromonas, and more beneficial bacteria such as Cetobacterium. The authors read this as better disease resistance, but it rests on microbiota composition rather than measured disease outcomes, and one paper cautions that the much simpler microbial community could also weaken immune stimulation.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼中，与池塘养殖（TPAS）相比，工厂化循环水养殖（RAS）下肠道菌群发生变化：潜在致病菌属（分枝杆菌、梭菌、葡萄球菌）和气单胞菌丰度下降，鲸杆菌等有益菌丰度上升。作者据此认为有利于提高抗病力，但这些结论依据的是菌群组成而非实际发病数据；另有研究指出，RAS中菌群结构明显简化，也可能削弱种间竞争和对免疫的刺激。

statement_en: In this study, fish living in saline-alkaline water showed higher abundances of Firmicutes and Staphylococcus saprophyticus compared to those in freshwater.
statement_zh: 在本研究中，与淡水相比，生活在盐碱水中的鱼表现出更高的厚壁菌门（Firmicutes）和腐生葡萄球菌（Staphylococcus saprophyticus）丰度。

statement_en: Regular use of bottom modifiers such as potassium monopersulfate compound can decompose residual feed and feces, reducing the breeding of pathogenic bacteria.
statement_zh: 定期使用过硫酸氢钾复合盐等底改剂可分解残饵粪便，减少病原菌滋生。

statement_en: Pathological changes such as congestion, edema, and vacuolation were detected in the observed liver tissues.
statement_zh: 在观察的肝脏组织中检测到了淤血、水肿和空泡等病理变化。

statement_en: The results showed that, compared with the untreated group, trypsin activity in larvae was significantly reduced at TI concentrations of 0.2, 2 and 20 mg/L.
statement_zh: 结果显示，与未处理组相比，在0.2、2和20 mg/L的TI浓度下，幼体内的胰蛋白酶活性显著降低。

statement_en: By regulating water flow (generally not less than 0.2 cubic meters per second) to maintain sufficient dissolved oxygen and prevent semi-floating eggs from sinking.
statement_zh: 通过调控水流量（一般不低于0.2立方米/秒）来保持充足溶氧量并防止半浮性卵下沉。

practice_en: strengthened water quality monitoring and environmental regulation
practice_zh: 加强水质监测和环境调控
statement_en: Strengthening water quality monitoring and environmental regulation during the T4 stage can avoid water quality deterioration and disease outbreaks caused by imbalance in microbial community homeostasis.
