statement_zh: 在T4阶段加强水质监测和环境调控可以避免因微生物群落稳态失衡导致的水质恶化和疾病爆发。

statement_en: Two papers, both inferred rather than directly tested, link water quality to disease in mandarin fish. One says worse water quality increases disease prevalence, with infection spreading through the water and over the body surface. The other attributes a lower risk of bacterial and opportunistic-pathogen infections in a recirculating system to strict water quality management (filtration, disinfection) together with biosecurity measures, which cut pathogen load and transmission.
statement_zh: 两篇论文都是推断性结论，认为水质与鳜鱼病害有关。一篇指出水质恶化会加重病害流行，病原可经水体和体表传播；另一篇认为在循环水养殖系统中，严格的水质管理（高效过滤、消毒）加上生物安保措施，降低了环境中的病原载量和传播风险，从而降低了鳜鱼感染顽固性细菌病和条件致病菌所致肠道或全身性疾病的风险。

statement_en: At 30 days post-infection, the average viral load in leukocytes of mandarin fish reared at 19°C was 18.5 ± 9.7 GEs/mg DNA, while that of surviving mandarin fish reared at 26°C was 33.9 ± 20.7 GEs/mg DNA.
statement_zh: 在感染后30天，19°C饲养的鳜鱼白细胞中的平均病毒载量为18.5 ± 9.7 GEs/mg DNA，而26°C饲养的存活鳜鱼为33.9 ± 20.7 GEs/mg DNA。

practice_en: recirculating filtration, disinfection and aeration system
practice_zh: 循环过滤消毒增氧系统
statement_en: The feeding trial was conducted in a recirculating aquaculture system equipped with a thermostat and ultraviolet lamps for disinfection.
statement_zh: 饲养试验在循环水系统中进行，该系统配备了恒温器和用于消毒的紫外线灯。

statement_en: The oxygen content in water samples was determined using the Winkler method.
statement_zh: 水样中的氧含量使用温克勒法测定。

practice_zh: 水体补充蜡样芽孢杆菌
statement_en: Supplementing Bacillus cereus (10^8 PFU/mL) in the culture water improved feed intake, growth and survival under pelleted feed conditions, which may be mediated by stimulating innate immunity and reshaping gut microbiota.
statement_zh: 在养殖水中补充蜡样芽孢杆菌（10^8 PFU/mL）改善了颗粒饲料条件下的摄食量、生长和存活率，这可能通过刺激先天免疫和重塑肠道菌群介导。

practice_en: running water cultivation in hatching tanks
statement_en: The effect of running water cultivation in hatching tanks is better than that of still water, and running water helps mandarin fish fry swallow bait fish.
statement_zh: 孵化缸流水培育的效果优于静水，且流水有助于鳜鱼苗吞食饵料鱼。

statement_en: 적정 성장 수온을 초과하면 어류의 사료 섭취가 감소하는 등의 부작용이 발생할 수 있다.

In one study of mandarin fish refeeding after fasting, a light intensity of 11.15 ± 2.01 lx was linked to a lower stress response and the highest intestinal digestive enzyme activity. However, the claims also report that protease, lipase and overall digestive enzyme activity were higher at 18.44 ± 3.00 lx, so the results on digestion are not fully consistent between the two intensities.
statement_zh: 在一项关于鳜鱼饥饿后重新投喂的研究中,11.15 ± 2.01 lx的光照强度下,鳜鱼的应激反应较低,肠道消化酶活性最高。但也有结果显示,18.44 ± 3.00 lx下蛋白酶、脂肪酶及消化酶活性高于11.15 lx,因此两种光强下的消化结果并不完全一致。

statement_en: This study applied different light intensities to Culter alburnus to simulate natural periodic light-dark cycles, aiming to evaluate changes in the activities of digestive and stress-related enzymes, and to determine whether satisfactory light intensity can alleviate stress caused by re-feeding after fasting.
statement_zh: 本研究对翘嘴鲌施加不同光照强度以模拟自然周期性明暗循环，旨在评估消化和应激相关酶活性的变化，并确定满意的光照强度是否能缓解禁食后重新投喂引起的应激。

statement_en: Implementing appropriate light control in aquaculture can promote feeding of mandarin fish and improve production efficiency.
statement_zh: 在养殖中实施适当的光照控制可以促进鳜鱼摄食并提高生产效率。

statement_en: Adding three probiotics to the culture water significantly improved the acceptance rate of pelleted feed and survival rate of mandarin fish.
statement_zh: 在养殖水中添加三种益生菌显著提高了摄食颗粒饲料的鳜鱼接受率和存活率。

statement_en: По мере повышения температуры активность питания окуней возрастала, а нормы кормления увеличивались.
Protein efficiency ratio, daily feed intake, and whole-body proximate composition were not affected by water temperature.
statement_zh: 蛋白质效率比、日摄食量和全身近似组成不受水温影响。

statement_en: The two claims, both from one 2023 paper, only describe how mandarin fish were acclimated to low flow (about 0.5 body lengths per second or below, for 10 to 30 minutes in one case and 2 hours in the other) before the flow was raised. They do not report any effect of this acclimation on handling or transport welfare.
statement_zh: 这两条结论都来自同一篇2023年的论文,只是描述了鳜鱼在提高流速之前如何做流速适应:先在约0.5体长/秒或更低的低流速下适应,一条是10至30分钟,另一条是2小时。两条都没有报告这种适应对操作和运输福利有什么影响。

statement_en: The study found that the optimal temperature for transporting mandarin fish is 10-15°C, and the vibration frequency should not exceed 50Hz.
statement_zh: 研究发现鳜鱼运输的最佳温度为10-15°C，且振动频率不应超过50Hz。

practice_zh: 工厂化循环水养殖系统
statement_en: Experimental fish were randomly assigned to recirculating aquaculture tanks, with 30 fish per tank, resulting in a stocking density of 17 fish/m³.
statement_zh: 实验鱼被随机分配到循环水养殖池中，每池30尾，导致放养密度为17尾/立方米。

statement_en: The aquaculture system used air-diffusing sand balls and nighttime aeration, and used fully aerated tap water as the water source.
statement_zh: 养殖系统采用充气沙球和夜间增氧，并使用充分曝气的自来水作为水源。

statement_en: Use sodium bicarbonate to adjust total alkalinity and maintain it at 90–120 mg/L.
statement_zh: 使用碳酸氢钠调节总碱度并维持在90–120 mg/L。

statement_en: The pH value of the group treated with 100 mmol/L allicin was 7.27, and the pH value of the group treated with 1 mol/L allicin was 7.22.
statement_zh: 100 mmol/L大蒜素处理组的pH值为7.27，1 mol/L大蒜素处理组的pH值为7.22。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, ammonia nitrogen exposure was harmful in the main study (S121): in juveniles, 96-hour mortality rose from 0% to 100% with concentration (LC50 12.91 mg/L total ammonia nitrogen). In the 28-day chronic test, it caused liver oxidative stress, higher serum liver enzymes (AST, ALT), lower total protein, and reduced gill Na+-K+-ATPase activity (day 15 only). Many enzyme and gene responses varied over time or between groups, and one other study (S054) found no deaths or added gill damage and an appetite suppression at high ammonia.
statement_zh: 鳜鱼氨氮暴露总体上造成不利影响(S121):幼鱼96小时死亡率随浓度升高从0%升至100%,总氨氮96小时LC50为12.91 mg/L;28天慢性试验中出现肝脏氧化应激、血清AST和ALT升高、总蛋白下降,鳃Na+-K+-ATPase活性在第15天受抑制。不少酶活性和基因表达随时间或组别变化不一致;另一项研究(S054)则称高氨氮下鳜鱼无死亡、鳃损伤未加重,但食欲受到抑制。

statement_en: Subsequently, the water in the tank was completely replaced, and an appropriate concentration of ammonia nitrogen solution was reintroduced to maintain consistency with the experimental design.
statement_zh: 随后完全更换水箱中的水，并重新引入适当浓度的氨氮溶液以维持实验设计的一致性。

statement_en: The claims say physical and chemical methods are used to remove ammonia pollution from aquaculture water, but they report no measured welfare effect on mandarin fish. They describe these methods as acting only after pollution has occurred, as costly, not very sustainable, at risk of secondary pollution, and as varying greatly in efficiency across systems, which is why the authors argue for preventing ammonia at the source.
statement_zh: 这些结论指出，物理和化学方法被用于去除养殖水体中的氨污染，但没有报告对鳜鱼福利的实际测量效果。文中认为这类方法只能在污染发生之后处理，运行成本高、可持续性差、有二次污染风险，而且在不同养殖系统中的效率差异很大，因此作者主张从源头上减少氨的产生。

statement_en: Planting aquatic plants such as duckweed and Vallisneria can provide hiding places and absorb eutrophication substances, purifying water quality.
statement_zh: 种植浮萍、苦草等水生植物可提供隐蔽场所并吸收富营养化物质，净化水质。

statement_en: 자동온도조절기와 기름보일러를 사용하여 사육 수온을 조절하였다.
Beneficial bacteria such as Bacillus and Pseudomonas improve water quality by decomposing residual feed and feces, while simultaneously inhibiting the proliferation of harmful bacteria.
statement_zh: 有益菌如芽孢杆菌属和假单胞菌属通过分解残余饲料和粪便改善水质，同时抑制有害细菌的增殖。

statement_en: In one 2025 paper on mandarin fish, biofloc technology kept total ammonia nitrogen low (below 0.24 ± 0.05 mg/L in the biofloc group), which the authors link to ammonia-removing bacteria such as Pseudomonas moorei when carbon is sufficient, and they conclude it gives a better water environment. Much of the rest is description or inference or background from another species, and within the biofloc group feed intake was positively correlated with TAN on most days.
statement_zh: 在一篇2025年的鳜鱼研究中，生物絮团组的总氨氮一直保持在较低水平（低于0.24 ± 0.05 mg/L），作者认为这可能与碳源充足时能去除氨氮的莫氏假单胞菌增多有关，并认为生物絮团技术能提供较好的水环境。其余内容多为方法描述、推断或来自其他鱼类的背景资料；另外在生物絮团组中，除第21–36天外，日摄食量与总氨氮呈显著正相关。

statement_en: In addition to providing sufficient oxygen for farmed fish, this procedure also kept organic particles and biomass in suspension.
statement_zh: 除了为养殖鱼类提供足够的氧气外，该程序还保持了有机颗粒和生物量的悬浮状态。

statement_en: Broodstock cultivation uses ponds with specific area and water depth, maintains fresh water quality, and feeds multiple types of live bait.
statement_zh: 亲鱼培育采用特定面积和水深的池塘，保持水质清新，并投喂多种活饵。

statement_en: Adding rice straw, bamboo powder, ammonium chloride and sodium nitrite according to a C/N ratio of 15, the initial total ammonia nitrogen and nitrite nitrogen levels were 5.36 ± 0.17 and 5.00 ± 0.10 mg/L, respectively.
statement_zh: 根据C/N比15添加稻草、竹粉、氯化铵和亚硝酸钠，初始总氨氮和亚硝酸盐氮水平分别为5.36 ± 0.17和5.00 ± 0.10 mg/L。

statement_en: The aquaculture system was equipped with a 500-watt air pump providing continuous aeration to each cage, and freshwater was supplied at approximately 20 liters per minute from 08:00 to 18:00 daily.
statement_zh: 水族系统配备了一个500瓦的气泵，为每个网箱提供连续曝气，并且淡水每天从08:00到18:00以约20升/分钟的速度供应。

statement_en: Dissolved oxygen was measured using an Oxygen Optode 3830 at a depth of 20 meters, and pH was measured at depths of 1 meter and 10 meters.
statement_zh: 在20米深度使用 Oxygen Optode 3830 测量溶解氧，并在1米和10米深度测量pH值。

statement_en: Two papers describe groundwater as the water source for mandarin fish culture and note that its temperature is relatively stable; one measured this and the other claimed it as a benefit. Neither claim reports an effect on fish welfare or any other water quality measure.
statement_zh: 两篇文献都提到鳜鱼养殖使用地下水作水源,且水温相对稳定,其中一篇为实测描述,另一篇为论文中的支持性说法。两条结论均未报告对鱼类福利或其他水质指标的具体影响。

practice_zh: 盐碱水配合高碳水饲料
statement_en: In saline-alkaline water, there was no significant difference in MDA content between the SAW+HC1 group and the SAW+NC group; a difference existed only in the SAW+HC2 group.
statement_zh: 在盐碱水中，SAW+HC1组与SAW+NC组的MDA含量无显著差异，仅在SAW+HC2组存在差异。

statement_en: The two claims only describe the practice and do not report a measured welfare effect: one background claim says mandarin fish prefer flowing, oxygen-rich water and swim against the current, and one study reports keeping dissolved oxygen at ≥ 5.5 mg/L.
statement_zh: 这两条结论只是描述了做法,并没有报告实测的福利效果:一条背景性说法指出鳜鱼喜欢溶氧丰富的流水环境并有逆流游动的习性,另一项研究则说明将溶解氧维持在≥5.5 mg/L。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, hyperoxia did not change ammonia accumulation in the water or ammonia excretion, but it improved ammonia tolerance: ammonia production fell, urea conversion and liver antioxidant enzyme activity rose, and the liver showed no tissue damage. However, plasma ammonia and urea were higher under hyperoxia (significantly so at 48 hours), and liver and blood ammonia were reported as not significantly changed, so hyperoxia did not lower ammonia levels in the body.
statement_zh: 对于鳜鱼,高氧暴露并未改变水体氨积累和氨排泄,但提高了鱼体对氨的耐受性:氨生成减少,尿素转化和肝脏抗氧化酶活性升高,肝组织未见损伤。不过高氧下血浆氨和尿素水平更高(48小时时差异显著),肝脏和血液氨含量也有报道称无明显变化,也就是说高氧并没有降低体内氨水平。

statement_en: The two claims mostly describe the practice rather than measured welfare outcomes: an intelligent system monitors key water quality indicators around the clock, and one paper claims it adjusts parameters such as water temperature and dissolved oxygen in real time to give mandarin fish a favourable environment. No measured effect on fish welfare is reported, and the benefit is stated as a claim only.
statement_zh: 这两条结论主要是在描述做法,而不是实测的福利效果:智能化系统全天24小时监测关键水质指标,其中一篇文章称该系统可实时调节水温、溶解氧等关键参数,为鳜鱼营造有利的生长环境。文中没有给出对鱼类福利的实测效果,这一好处只是文章的说法。

practice_en: applying lc50 and safety thresholds in management
statement_en: By integrating LC50 values and safety thresholds into management practices, stakeholders can enhance the resistance of Chinese mandarin fish populations to ammonia nitrogen stress, promoting ecological and economic sustainability.
statement_zh: 通过将LC50值和安全阈值整合到管理实践中，利益相关者可以增强中国鳜鱼种群对氨氮胁迫的抵抗力，促进生态和经济可持续性。

practice_zh: 线性插值计算安全浓度
statement_en: The 96-hour LC50 value was determined using linear interpolation, and the safe ammonia nitrogen concentration (SC) for mandarin fish was estimated using the formula SC = 0.1 × 96 h-LC50.
statement_zh: 采用线性插值法确定96小时LC50值，并估算鳜鱼安全的氨氮安全浓度（SC），计算公式为SC = 0.1 × 96 h-LC 50。

statement_en: In one study, low dissolved oxygen made mandarin fish excrete less ammonia, so ammonia in the water was about 24% lower at 48 hours, while liver ammonia rose. The fish cut ammonia production, shifted toward urea, and upregulated excretion-related transporters as compensation.
statement_zh: 一项研究显示,低溶氧胁迫下鳜的氨排泄率显著下降,48小时时水体中NH4+-N积累减少24.06%,而肝脏氨含量升高。鳜通过下调氨的生成、促进尿素合成,并上调RhG和NHE3等相关转运蛋白来做补偿性应对。

statement_en: With weak aeration, counting of surviving individuals, removal of dead bodies, water exchange, and feed density adjustment were carried out every 24 hours.
statement_zh: 弱い通気を行い、24時間ごとに生存個体の計数、死骸除去、換水、餌密度調整を実施した。

statement_en: Future research should add experimental requirements for comprehensive conditions such as dissolved oxygen, transparency, flow velocity, and water pressure to obtain baseline data that can be used for effective resource protection.
statement_zh: 后续研究应增加溶解氧、透明度、流速、水压等综合条件的实验要求，以获取可用于有效保护资源的基础数据。

statement_en: Two background claims from one paper say that nitrification and denitrification microorganisms (such as Nitrosomonas, Nitrobacter and Nitrospira) remove excess nitrogen and phosphorus, and that this prevents water quality deterioration that would otherwise harm fish. These are general statements, not measured results in mandarin fish, and no conditions are given.
statement_zh: 同一篇论文中的两条背景性论述指出,硝化和反硝化微生物(如亚硝化单胞菌、硝化杆菌、硝化螺菌)可去除水中过量的氮和磷,从而防止水质恶化对鱼造成危害。这只是一般性说明,并非鳜鱼的实测结果,也未给出具体条件。

statement_en: Because no fertilizer was applied during the trial, severe eutrophication of the pond water did not occur as it does in typical intensive fish ponds.
statement_zh: 由于试验过程中不施肥，因此不像一般精养鱼池那样出现严重的池水富营养化。

statement_en: The two claims point in different directions for outdoor pond farming of mandarin fish. One background statement says ponds are easily affected by seasons, weather and external water sources, so water quality is unstable and hard to manage in a standard way. One measured claim reports that during the farming period dissolved oxygen stayed above 5.0 mg/L, pH was 7-8, ammonia nitrogen was below 1.2 mg/L and nitrite below 0.15 mg/L, at a stocking density of 3 fish/m³.
statement_zh: 关于鳜鱼室外池塘养殖的水质，两条证据并不一致。一条背景性说法指出，池塘易受季节、天气和外部水源影响，水质不稳定，难以标准化管理。另一条实测结果显示，在养殖期间、放养密度为3尾/m³时，溶解氧高于5.0 mg/L，pH为7-8，氨氮低于1.2 mg/L，亚硝酸盐低于0.15 mg/L。

statement_en: Ozone and hydrogen peroxide affect off-flavor compounds and water quality in recirculating aquaculture systems.
statement_zh: 臭氧和过氧化氢对循环水养殖系统中的异味化合物和水质有影响。

statement_en: Most claims simply describe water-change routines for mandarin fish (from about 1% to 33–50% replacement, once a week to several times a day) and say they are used to remove food residue and feces and keep water clean; one claim says prompt water change before breathing stops lets most fish recover, while unchanged water led to rapid death. One early claim reports switching to periodic water change because of poor drainage under micro-flow culture, and no claim compares regimes or quantifies a welfare outcome.
statement_zh: 多数结论只是描述鳜鱼的换水做法(换水量从约1%到每天33–50%不等,频率从每周一次到每天数次),目的是清除残饵和粪便、保持水质清洁;有一条提到在呼吸停止前及时换水,多数鱼能恢复,不换水则很快死亡。另有早期一条说因微流水养殖排水不畅而改为定期加水换水。没有结论比较不同换水方案或给出具体的福利量化结果。

statement_en: The two claims do not show pH measurement changing mandarin fish welfare: one only describes using a pH meter to measure pH, and the other infers that pH did not change significantly among ammonia nitrogen groups, so its effect on enzyme activity could be ignored.
statement_zh: 这两条结论都没有显示pH测量本身对鳜鱼福利有影响:一条只是说明用pH计测定pH值,另一条推断各氨氮组之间水体pH变化不显著,因此pH对酶活性的影响可以忽略。

statement_en: Releasing filter-feeding animals can purify water quality and control pathogen vectors.
statement_zh: 投放滤食性动物可净化水质并控制病原体载体。

statement_en: As temperature increases, CAT is upregulated, indicating enhanced detoxification during this process, and previous studies have also reported the same result.
statement_zh: 随着温度升高，CAT上调，表明该过程中解毒作用增强，且先前研究也报道了相同结果。

practice_zh: 工厂化循环水养殖系统
statement_en: Claims on mandarin fish in recirculating aquaculture systems point to better or more stable water quality: one study measured higher dissolved oxygen and improved ammonia nitrogen, nitrite nitrogen, phosphorus and chemical oxygen demand, another claimed high water quality was maintained, and two background statements describe water quality as more controllable. A fifth claim only notes that nitrogen matters for fish growth and water quality in these systems, and no claim reports a negative or null effect.
statement_zh: 关于鳜鱼工业循环水养殖系统（RAS）的研究结论都倾向于水质更好、更稳定：一项实测发现溶解氧更高，总氨氮、亚硝酸盐氮、磷和化学需氧量等指标也有改善；另一项称该模式能保持较高水质；还有两篇背景性论述提到水质参数更可控。另有一条只是指出氮在RAS中对鱼的生长和水质很重要，没有说明效果。没有结论报告负面影响或无效果。

statement_en: In one study of mandarin fish ponds, a rice floating bed was associated with lower ammonium, nitrite, nitrate, total nitrogen, total phosphorus and alkalinity in the water than in control ponds, with ammonium staying nearly unchanged under the bed. Microbial diversity in the water decreased with the floating bed, which the authors read as a counter-effect, while alkalinity kept rising in the bed group.
statement_zh: 在一项鳜鱼池塘研究中,与对照池相比,设置水稻浮床的池塘水体中氨氮、亚硝酸盐氮、硝酸盐氮、总氮、总磷和碱度都更低,其中浮床组氨氮变化很小。不过浮床组水体微生物多样性下降,作者将其视为不利的一面;浮床组碱度仍持续上升。

statement_en: When using rice straw-based biofloc to farm Litopenaeus vannamei, total ammonia nitrogen and nitrite nitrogen levels were maintained below 1 mg/L throughout the entire 30-day culture period.
statement_zh: 在利用稻草基质生物絮团养殖凡纳滨对虾时，整个30天养殖期内总氨氮和亚硝酸盐氮水平维持在1毫克/升以下。

statement_en: In this study, saline-alkali stress promoted the expression of two insulin receptors (insra and insrb) in the liver of mandarin fish.
statement_zh: 在本研究中，盐碱胁迫促进了鳜鱼肝脏中两种胰岛素受体（insra和insrb）的表达。

statement_en: For mandarin fish in saline-alkaline water, the two claims point in different directions. One says long-term saline-alkali stress may harm growth, health and even survival. The other reports that intestinal goblet cells increased significantly, which would help protect the gut lining from alkali damage by producing more mucus. The claims give no specific water conditions, and the first is a general statement rather than a measured result.
statement_zh: 对于盐碱水养殖的鳜鱼，两条结论方向不一。一条指出长期盐碱胁迫可能不利于鱼的生长和健康，甚至导致死亡；另一条是实测结果，显示肠道杯状细胞数量显著增加，分泌更多黏液，从而保护肠上皮免受碱性毒害。两条结论都没有给出具体的水质条件，前一条也只是一般性的说法，并非实测结果。

statement_en: The three claims only describe siphon cleaning as a routine step after feeding (removing feces, dead larvae or uneaten feed, in one case with partial water change), at 30 minutes to 2 hours after feeding. They do not report a measured effect on water quality, so what the practice did to welfare is not stated.
statement_zh: 这三条结论只是描述了投喂后用虹吸管清理的常规操作(清除粪便、死亡仔鱼或残饵,其中一条还伴随部分换水),时间在投喂后30分钟至2小时之间。均未给出对水质的具体影响结果,因此该做法对鳜鱼福利的作用并未说明。

statement_en: Each cage bottom is equipped with a disc of 100 cm diameter to collect leftover feed and feces.
statement_zh: 每个笼子底部装有直径100厘米的圆盘，用于收集残饵和粪便。

statement_en: After the third batch of induced spawning, parent fish were placed in a 150 cubic meter spawning pool, maintaining a water depth of 30-40 cm and regularly adding new water.
statement_zh: 第三批催产后的亲鱼放入150立方米产卵池，保持30-40cm水深并定期注新水。

practice_zh: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯
statement_en: Both T1 and T2 concentrations affected CAT activity, but no significant difference was observed between them.
statement_zh: T1和T2浓度均影响CAT活性，但两者之间未观察到显著差异。

practice_en: temperature control and regular water changes
statement_en: Water temperature was maintained at 24±2°C, and a recirculating water system was used to change the water twice a week.
statement_zh: 水温维持在24±2°C，并使用循环水系统每周换水两次。

statement_en: The water transparency in aquaculture ponds should be maintained at 30-40 cm to ensure clean water quality and sufficient light.
statement_zh: 养殖池塘水体透明度应维持在30-40厘米以保证水质清洁和光照充足。

statement_en: Непоеденная живая кормовая рыба удалялась из садков каждые 30 дней для контроля потребления и предотвращения загрязнения воды.
During the hot season, it is recommended to change one-third of the water every 3-5 days, and use aerators at night and on rainy or cloudy days to increase dissolved oxygen.
statement_zh: 高温季节建议每3-5天换水三分之一，并在夜间和阴雨天使用增氧机以提高溶解氧。

statement_en: After feeding, remove and weigh the leftover feed to record food consumption, and replace 1/3 to 1/2 of the water.
statement_zh: 投喂后移除并称量残饵以记录摄食量，并更换1/3至1/2的水。

statement_en: Ammonia nitrogen, nitrite nitrogen, and total alkalinity were determined according to literature methods.
statement_zh: 氨氮、亚硝酸盐氮和总碱度按照文献方法测定。

statement_en: Most claims simply describe how water quality was held in rearing trials (dissolved oxygen about 5 mg/L or higher, ammonia nitrogen mostly below 0.2 mg/L, pH about 7–8.5, and temperatures that varied by study) and state that these are suitable or safe ranges, without reporting a measured welfare outcome. The few claims with effects say that mandarin fish need clean, oxygen-rich water and surface when oxygen is short in fertile water, and that ammonia tolerance is low (96-h LC50 12.91 mg/L), so strict control is needed.
statement_zh: 多数文献只是描述试验中如何控制水质(溶氧多在5 mg/L以上,氨氮多低于0.2 mg/L,pH约7–8.5,水温各研究不一),并称这些范围适宜或安全,并未给出实测的福利效果。少数涉及影响的结论指出:鳜对水质要求高,需要清洁、富氧的水体,水过肥缺氧时易浮头;其氨氮耐受性较低(96 h LC50为12.91 mg/L),因此需要严格控制水质。

statement_en: The claims mostly describe how water quality was monitored in mandarin fish culture (pH, dissolved oxygen, temperature, ammonia nitrogen, nitrite, at intervals from daily to every five days) and none reports a measured effect of monitoring on fish welfare. A few state that regular monitoring is central to environmental control, or give limits of total ammonia nitrogen below 0.5 mg/L and nitrite below 0.05 mg/L.
statement_zh: 这些研究大多只是描述鳜鱼养殖中如何开展水质监测（监测pH、溶氧、水温、氨氮、亚硝酸盐等，频率从每天到每五天不等），没有一条报告水质监测对鱼类福利的实际影响。只有少数提到定期监测是环境防控的核心，并给出总氨氮低于0.5 mg/L、亚硝酸盐低于0.05 mg/L的要求。

statement_en: The water source was pond water, which was filtered and aerated in a reservoir for 48 hours.
statement_zh: 水源为池塘水，经过过滤并在蓄水池中曝气48小时。

practice_en: recirculating filtration, disinfection and aeration system
practice_zh: 循环过滤消毒增氧系统
statement_en: The two claims only describe how the systems were set up, not measured effects on welfare. One used activated-carbon-filtered tap water with overflow drainage and continuous aeration; the other used sponge filters, coral stones and UV lamps, with about 10% of the water replaced daily. Neither claim reports a result for mandarin fish water quality or welfare.
statement_zh: 这两条结论都只是描述系统的配置,并没有给出对鳜鱼福利的实际效果。一篇用活性炭过滤的自来水,溢流排水并持续充气;另一篇用海绵过滤器、珊瑚石和紫外灯过滤消毒,每天换水约10%。两条都没有报告水质或福利方面的结果。

practice_en: selective breeding for formulated feed acceptance
statement_en: Selecting easily domesticated individuals through molecular markers and feeding them large amounts of artificial feed can effectively solve problems such as high costs, severe pollution, and diseases in mandarin fish farming.
statement_zh: 通过分子标记选择易驯化个体并大规模投喂人工饲料，可有效解决鳜养殖的高成本、严重污染和疾病等问题。

practice_en: selective breeding for formulated feed acceptance
statement_en: After years of domestication and selective breeding, mandarin fish can now sustainably consume formulated feed.
statement_zh: 经过数年的驯化和选育，鳜鱼现在能够可持续地摄食配合饲料。

practice_en: targeted probiotics/prebiotics supplementation in high-carbohydrate diets
practice_zh: 高碳水饲料中添加靶向益生菌/益生元
statement_en: Both claims come from one paper and are forward-looking rather than tested: they say that finding the gut microbiota and metabolites behind high-carbohydrate-diet intestinal damage and inflammation could help select targeted probiotics or prebiotics to ease that damage and improve tolerance. No claim reports that such a supplement was actually given or measured for its effect on mandarin fish welfare.
statement_zh: 这两条结论都来自同一篇论文,属于推测和推断,并没有实际验证:研究认为,查明肠道菌群及其代谢物在高碳水饲料引起的肠道损伤和炎症中的作用,有助于筛选靶向益生菌或益生元,用来减轻肠道损伤、提高鳜鱼对高碳水饲料的耐受性。但这些结论都没有报告实际添加益生菌或益生元后对鳜鱼福利的效果。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, high-carbohydrate diets were mostly linked to worse health: oxidative stress, liver cell apoptosis, endoplasmic reticulum stress, intestinal damage, raised blood glucose, and lower antioxidant capacity and immunity. A medium-carbohydrate diet raised plasma immune-related proteins. In saline-alkali water, a 13% carbohydrate diet reduced oxidative and tissue damage, though in the same study carbohydrate supplementation also increased MDA accumulation and tissue changes. The claims describe stress, immune and tissue effects rather than specific diseases or parasites, apart from one background statement of low resistance and high mortality on excess carbohydrate.
statement_zh: 对鳜鱼来说，高碳水化合物饲料大多与健康变差有关：出现氧化应激、肝细胞凋亡、内质网应激、肠道损伤、血糖升高，抗氧化能力和免疫力下降。中等碳水化合物水平可提高血浆中与免疫相关的蛋白水平。在盐碱水条件下，13%碳水化合物饲料减轻了氧化和组织损伤，但同一研究中添加碳水化合物也使MDA积累增加、组织出现病变。这些结论讲的是应激、免疫和组织损伤，并没有直接涉及具体的疾病或寄生虫，只有一条背景性说法提到碳水化合物过量会导致死亡率高、抵抗力低。

practice_en: first feeding with artemia versus silver carp fry
practice_zh: 卤虫与鲢仔鱼开口饵料投喂
statement_en: In one study of mandarin fish larvae, those first fed Artemia showed higher expression of inflammation-related factors during days 4-9 post-hatching, and higher expression of specific immune-related genes as rearing time increased, than larvae fed silver carp fry. The authors read this as possible immune activation; the claims measure gene expression only and do not report disease or parasite outcomes.
statement_zh: 在一项针对鳜仔鱼的研究中,开口饵料投喂卤虫的仔鱼,在孵化后第4–9天炎症相关因子的相对表达量高于投喂鲢仔鱼的仔鱼,且随养殖时间延长,特定免疫相关基因的表达量也显著更高。作者认为这可能说明免疫系统被激活;但这些结果只是基因表达的测定,并没有给出疾病或寄生虫方面的实际结果。

practice_zh: 人工饲料替代活饵养殖
statement_en: Claims conflict: background statements say feed can lower disease risk, including transmission from live bait fish. But the measured results in mandarin fish fed artificial feed show liver damage, more liver and muscle oxidative stress and inflammation, lower intestinal microbial diversity and weaker immune-related enzyme activity, and background reports of high mortality, so artificial feed was linked to poorer health and immunity, not better disease resistance.
statement_zh: 各研究结论并不一致：背景性陈述认为投喂配合饲料可降低发病和活饵鱼带来的病原传播风险；但在实测结果中，投喂人工饲料的鳜出现肝脏损伤、肝脏和肌肉氧化应激与炎症加重、肠道菌群多样性降低、免疫相关酶活性下降，另有背景文献提到死亡率偏高，说明人工饲料与健康和免疫力下降相关，而不是抗病力提高。

practice_zh: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌
statement_en: In one study on mandarin fish, dietary Bacillus subtilis 1-C-7 improved gut microbiota and gut health and raised resistance to an Aeromonas hydrophila challenge, with lower mortality in the supplemented groups, though overall survival rate did not differ significantly between groups. The benefits were tied to the low dose (0.85 × 10^8 CFU/kg), while the higher doses (0.95 × 10^9 and 0.91 × 10^10 CFU/kg) may be harmful, and liver health got worse at the highest dose.
statement_zh: 在一项针对鳜鱼的研究中,日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7可改善肠道菌群和肠道健康,并提高对嗜水气单胞菌攻毒的抗病力,添加组攻毒后死亡率降低,但各组总体成活率差异不显著。这些益处与低剂量(0.85×10^8 CFU/kg)相关,而较高剂量(0.95×10^9和0.91×10^10 CFU/kg)可能对健康有害,最高剂量下肝脏健康反而变差。

practice_en: dietary C-I20 supplementation in soybean meal diets
statement_en: In mandarin fish fed soybean meal-based diets for 10 weeks, adding C-I20 at 160 or 320 mg/Kg reduced inflammation and damage in the liver, kidneys and spleen (including lower liver enzymes ALT, ALP and AST) and kept intestinal mucus and goblet cells at adequate levels. Lower doses (80 and 40 mg/Kg) and the control showed more severe lesions, and no intestinal tissue lesions were seen in any group.
statement_zh: 在以豆粕为基础的日粮中投喂鳜鱼10周,添加160或320 mg/Kg的C-I20可减轻肝脏、肾脏和脾脏的炎症与损伤(血清ALT、ALP、AST也较低),并使肠道黏液和杯状细胞维持在适宜水平;80和40 mg/Kg低剂量组及对照组的组织病变更严重,而各组肠道HE切片均未见组织病变。

statement_en: The two claims are background statements, not tests on mandarin fish disease or parasites. One says dietary taurine regulated liver oxidative status, endoplasmic reticulum stress and inflammation in juvenile turbot on high-carbohydrate diets. The other says taurine eased metabolic disorders caused by high-fat diets. Neither reports an effect on disease or parasite problems in mandarin fish.
statement_zh: 这两条结论都只是背景性描述,并非针对鳜鱼疾病或寄生虫的试验。一条称,在高碳水化合物饲料下,日粮牛磺酸可调节大菱鲆幼鱼的肝脏氧化状态、内质网应激和炎症;另一条称,牛磺酸可缓解高脂饲料引起的代谢紊乱。两条都没有报告牛磺酸对鳜鱼疾病或寄生虫问题的影响。

statement_en: In one study of mandarin fish larvae, the type of first feed changed immune-related gene expression, and transcriptome analysis showed enrichment of immune stress pathways (such as IL-17 and Toll-like receptors) and of apoptosis and senescence pathways. The claims describe these gene-level changes only and do not report disease or parasite outcomes, so the effect on disease welfare is not shown.
statement_zh: 在一项针对鳜鱼苗的研究中,不同开口饵料会改变免疫相关基因的表达,转录组分析显示IL-17、Toll样受体等免疫应激相关通路以及细胞凋亡和衰老通路出现富集。这些结论只描述了基因水平的变化,没有给出发病或寄生虫方面的结果,因此对疾病福利的影响尚不明确。

statement_en: The MDA content in the brain and liver tissues of mandarin fish fed CF was higher, indicating that mandarin fish fed CF are more susceptible to membrane lipid oxidation.
statement_zh: 饲喂CF的鳜脑和肝组织中的MDA含量较高，表明饲喂CF的鳜更容易受到膜脂质氧化的影响。

statement_en: In one 2015 study of mandarin fish, feeding frozen feed (and artificial feed) was linked to intestinal damage: abnormal intestinal lining cells, shortened microvilli, fewer goblet cells (read as a weaker defense) and impaired digestion and absorption. The paper attributes slower growth to lower digestive enzyme activity and gut pathology; the claims do not report infection or parasite outcomes directly.
statement_zh: 一项2015年的鳜鱼研究显示,投喂冷冻饲料(以及配合饲料)的鱼肠道出现病理变化:肠黏膜上皮细胞发育不良、微绒毛变短、吸收泡减少、固有层增生,杯状细胞数量减少,研究者据此认为肠道防御能力减弱,消化吸收受到不利影响。该文认为冷冻和人工饲料降低消化酶活性并造成消化道病变,是鱼生长受限的主要原因;这些结论并未直接涉及感染或寄生虫的发病情况。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, a 20% gelatinized starch diet mostly worsened gut health: it was linked to intestinal damage, higher gut permeability, lower lysozyme activity, lipid accumulation in the gut, disturbed gut microbiota and higher plasma endotoxin. Some measures went the other way (lower hindgut endotoxin and lower expression of inflammatory genes), and a moderate level (10%) improved microbial diversity and beneficial bacteria with normal intestinal villi. The claims do not directly measure disease or parasite infection.
statement_zh: 对鳜鱼来说，日粮糊化淀粉达到20%时，肠道健康总体变差：肠绒毛出现严重病变，肠通透性升高，溶菌酶活性下降，肠道脂滴大量沉积，肠道菌群紊乱，血浆内毒素升高。但也有指标相反（后肠内毒素降低、炎症因子基因表达下降）。适中水平（10%）则提高了肠道菌群多样性和有益菌丰度，肠绒毛正常。这些结果并未直接测定疾病或寄生虫感染。

statement_en: In cell-culture work from one paper, hesperetin reduced SCRV infection: it lowered expression of the SCRV nucleoprotein, blocked viral entry into cells, and reduced SCRV-induced cell apoptosis (18.84% with SCRV alone versus 11.78% with hesperetin at 24 hours). It lowered caspase-3 and caspase-9 activity but not caspase-8 activity. The claims describe cells, not live fish, so effects on fish disease are not shown.
statement_zh: 这篇论文在细胞水平的研究显示,橙皮素能减轻SCRV感染:降低SCRV核蛋白表达,阻断病毒进入细胞,并减少病毒引起的细胞凋亡(24小时时单独感染组为18.84%,加橙皮素后为11.78%)。它降低了caspase-3和caspase-9的活性,但对caspase-8活性没有显著影响。这些结果都来自细胞试验,没有活鱼的数据,因此还不能说明对鱼体发病的作用。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, high-fat diets were linked to liver damage in both papers: enlarged lipid droplets, vacuolization, fat build-up (steatosis), lipid metabolic disorder, and, with high carbohydrate as well, hepatocyte necrosis and raised MDA (peroxidative damage). The claims describe liver injury and do not report infection or parasite outcomes directly.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼上,两项研究都发现高脂日粮会造成肝脏损伤:肝细胞脂滴增大、空泡化、脂肪沉积(脂肪肝)和脂代谢紊乱;高脂再加高碳水时,还出现肝细胞坏死和MDA升高(过氧化损伤)。这些结果说的是肝脏损伤,并没有直接涉及感染或寄生虫方面的结果。

practice_en: soy protein concentrate hydrolysate replacing fish meal
practice_zh: 大豆浓缩蛋白水解物（SPCH）替代鱼粉
statement_en: In mandarin fish, replacing fish meal with SPCH had a dose-dependent effect on gut inflammation: an appropriate amount was said to improve gut health, but above a replacement rate of about 37% midgut pro-inflammatory genes (5lox, il8, il1β) were upregulated, and excessive replacement led to some intestinal inflammation and hepatic lipid deposition. The inflammation-related genes changed in a quadratic pattern, and the authors link the high-level effect to the p38 MAPK/NF-κB pathway; these claims concern gut inflammation, not disease or parasite infection directly.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼中，用SPCH替代鱼粉对肠道炎症的影响与替代水平有关：适量替代可改善肠道健康，但替代比例超过约37%时，中肠促炎基因（5lox、il8、il1β）表达上调，过量替代会导致一定程度的肝脏脂质沉积和肠道炎症。炎症相关基因呈二次曲线变化，作者认为高水平替代可能通过p38 MAPK/NF-κB通路引起炎症；这些结果反映的是肠道炎症，并非直接针对疾病或寄生虫感染。

practice_zh: 植物乳杆菌益生菌添加
statement_en: In mandarin fish fed pelleted feed, adding L. plantarum (tested together with L. rhamnosus and C. butyricum) reduced the drop in survival and the rise in mortality, eased the fall in serum lysozyme and IgM, and lowered pathogenic Aeromonas abundance; L. plantarum alone raised serum lysozyme and IgM. Results were mixed for some markers: serum CRP was unchanged, and liver catalase and gill malondialdehyde both rose in one claim, though other claims report lower MDA and better antioxidant capacity.
statement_zh: 在投喂配合颗粒饲料的鳜鱼中，添加植物乳杆菌（与鼠李糖乳杆菌、丁酸梭菌一同试验）可减轻成活率下降和死亡率上升，缓解血清溶菌酶和IgM的下降，并降低致病性气单胞菌的丰度；单独添加植物乳杆菌组的血清溶菌酶和IgM有所升高。部分指标结果不一：血清CRP无显著变化，有一条结论称肝脏过氧化氢酶和鳃丙二醛均升高，而其他结论则显示丙二醛降低、抗氧化能力增强。

statement_en: In this study, long-term feeding of artificial diets significantly reduced the transcription levels of antioxidant stress-related genes and the enzyme activities of the antioxidant defense system, and increased MDA content in the liver.
statement_zh: 本研究中，长期投喂人工饲料显著降低了抗氧化应激相关基因的转录水平和抗氧化防御系统的酶活性，并增加了肝脏中的MDA含量。

statement_en: In mandarin fish fed granular feed, three probiotics (with Lactobacillus plantarum strongest) restored serum lysozyme and IgM, antioxidant enzyme activity and appetite-related gene expression, lowered gut Aeromonas and improved foregut structure over 28 days. The authors suggest this gut-health effect may partly explain higher survival, but that is inferred, and the other claims are background reports of antibacterial and immune benefits.
statement_zh: 在投喂配合饲料的鳜鱼中,三种益生菌(以植物乳杆菌效果最明显)在28天内使血清溶菌酶和IgM含量、抗氧化酶活性及食欲相关因子表达得到恢复,降低了肠道中气单胞菌的丰度,并改善了前肠组织结构。作者推测肠道健康的改善可能是成活率提高的原因之一,但这只是推断;其余论述属于有关抗菌和免疫作用的背景报道。

statement_en: In addition, protease supplementation significantly reduced the expression of deamination-related genes in the muscle of Chinese mandarin fish, effectively preventing elevated blood ammonia levels and subsequent ammonia toxicity.
statement_zh: 此外，补充蛋白酶显著降低了中国鳜鱼肌肉中脱氨相关基因的表达，有效防止了血氨水平升高及随后的氨毒性。

statement_en: Compared with the other groups, alanine aminotransferase and aspartate aminotransferase levels were significantly increased in groups A and E; however, there was no significant difference in alkaline phosphatase levels among the groups.
statement_zh: 与其余各组相比，A组和E组的丙氨酸氨基转移酶和天冬氨酸氨基转移酶显著升高；然而，各组间的碱性磷酸酶水平无差异。

practice_zh: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯
statement_en: Most claims are background or inferred and say tributyrin may support gut health in mandarin fish by raising antioxidant enzyme activity and reducing intestinal inflammation, without directly measuring disease or parasite outcomes. The only measured claim is mixed: LPS activity changed significantly at the T2 tributyrin level but not at T1.
statement_zh: 大多数结论属于背景引述或推断,认为饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯可能通过提高抗氧化酶活性、减轻肠道炎症来改善鳜鱼肠道健康,但并未直接测定疾病或寄生虫方面的结果。唯一的实测结果表现不一:LPS活性在T2添加水平下有显著变化,在T1水平下则无显著差异。

statement_en: In one 2024 study, two Weissella strains (W. confusa RM125 and W. cibaria SJ548) inhibited several common aquaculture pathogens in lab sensitivity tests, which the authors take as showing potential as probiotics; the claims describe no tests on the fish themselves. The effect varied by pathogen: W. confusa RM125 was highly inhibitory against V. harveyi, moderately against S. aureus and V. parahaemolyticus, and only weakly against E. coli, A. hydrophila, S. enterica, V. anguillarum and V. alginolyticus.
statement_zh: 一项2024年的研究中，两株魏斯氏菌（W. confusa RM125和W. cibaria SJ548）在实验室药敏（抑菌）试验中对多种常见水产病原菌有抑制作用，作者认为它们有作为益生菌的潜力；这些结论中没有提到在鱼体上的试验。抑菌效果因病原而异：RM125对哈维氏弧菌高度敏感，对金黄色葡萄球菌和副溶血弧菌为中等敏感，对大肠杆菌、嗜水气单胞菌、肠道沙门氏菌、鳗弧菌和溶藻弧菌则只有较弱的抑制。

statement_en: In one study of isoenergetic diets (18 kJ/g) fed to mandarin fish, the dietary protein/energy ratio changed feeding-related outcomes: the medium ratio (group C) gave the best growth and feed utilization and the lowest feed conversion ratio, the lowest ratio (group A) gave the poorest growth and feed utilization, and a high ratio gave higher feed intake than a low ratio. The ratio altered expression of the appetite genes NPY and AgRP but not CART or POMC, and low ratios shifted growth-related pathway genes towards reduced protein synthesis, while the authors suggest that ratios above the optimum may affect ammonia nitrogen production and muscle quality.
statement_zh: 在一项等能（18 kJ/g）日粮投喂鳜鱼的研究中，日粮蛋白能量比影响了摄食相关指标：中等蛋白能量比组（C组）生长和饲料利用最好、饲料系数最低，最低蛋白能量比组（A组）生长和饲料利用最差，高蛋白能量比组的摄食量高于低蛋白能量比组。蛋白能量比改变了食欲相关基因NPY和AgRP的表达，但对CART和POMC没有影响；低蛋白能量比使生长相关通路基因趋向蛋白合成下降，作者还推测蛋白能量比高于最适值时可能影响氨氮产生和肌肉品质。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, adding protease to feed mostly improved feeding: at 0.4 to 1.6 g/kg feed intake rose, appetite-gene expression shifted toward more feeding, and growth and feed conversion improved (1.6 g/kg gave the clearest gains). The lowest dose (0.2 g/kg) did not change feed intake and altered appetite genes in a way the authors read as negative, protein efficiency was lower at the two lower doses, and the background claims note that excessive protease can harm growth.
statement_zh: 在鲈鱼(鳜鱼)饲料中添加蛋白酶,总体上能促进摄食:添加0.4~1.6 g/kg时采食量增加,食欲相关基因表达向促进摄食方向变化,生长和饲料系数也有改善,其中1.6 g/kg效果最明显。但最低剂量0.2 g/kg对采食量没有影响,食欲基因的变化被作者认为对摄食不利;较低剂量组的蛋白质效率也偏低;背景文献还提到蛋白酶添加过量可能不利于生长。

statement_en: The claims suggest that dietary amino acids can influence feeding, but they are mostly background statements and not tests in mandarin fish. Arginine and leucine are proposed to stimulate feeding behaviour through trypsin, and tryptophan and glutamine raised food intake in carp. Leucine reduced food intake in golden pompano, so the effect depends on the amino acid and the species.
statement_zh: 这些结论表明，饲料中添加氨基酸可能影响摄食，但多为背景性陈述，并非在鳜鱼上的试验。精氨酸和亮氨酸被认为可通过胰蛋白酶促进摄食行为，色氨酸和谷氨酰胺在鲤鱼中提高了摄食量；但亮氨酸在金鲳鱼中却降低了摄食量，说明效果因氨基酸种类和鱼种而异。

practice_en: first feeding with artemia versus silver carp fry
practice_zh: 卤虫与鲢仔鱼开口饵料投喂
statement_en: In one study of mandarin fish larvae, first feeding with Artemia gave lower survival than silver carp fry (43% vs 69%), and pepsin activity at 4 days was about 40 times higher in the silver carp group. Lipase activity at 4 and 6 days was higher in the Artemia group, so digestive enzyme results were mixed.
statement_zh: 在一项针对鳜仔鱼的研究中,开口饵料用卤虫的成活率低于用鲢仔鱼(43%对69%),4日龄时鲢仔鱼组的胃蛋白酶活性约为卤虫组的40倍;但4日龄和6日龄时卤虫组的脂肪酶活性更高,说明消化酶方面结果不一致。

practice_zh: 人工饲料替代活饵养殖
statement_en: Claims on replacing live bait with artificial feed in mandarin fish are mixed, with more pointing to feeding difficulty than to benefit. Several report poor acceptance and adaptation, lower digestive enzyme activity (especially protease), lower survival than live bait without probiotics, and variable growth and liver metabolic problems. Others report that artificial feed can work in intensive farming, with better feed conversion, and that co-feeding while withdrawing live bait improved growth and acceptance; gut microbiota changes were described, with one pond study finding no change in overall community structure.
statement_zh: 关于用人工饲料替代活饵养殖鳜鱼，结果不一，更多证据指向摄食和适应上的困难。多项结果提到鳜鱼对人工饲料接受和适应差、消化酶（尤其是蛋白酶）活性低、不加益生菌时成活率低于活饵组，生长差异大且有肝脏代谢问题。另一些研究则认为人工饲料可用于集约化养殖，饵料系数较好，逐步减少活饵并配合混投可提高生长和摄食接受度；肠道菌群有变化，但有一项池塘研究显示整体群落结构未改变。

statement_en: This study also provides the necessary theoretical basis for artificial first-feeding diets for juvenile mandarin fish.
statement_zh: 本研究也为鳜鱼幼鱼的人工开口饵料提供了必要的理论依据。

practice_en: feed transition from live/fresh feed to artificial feed
practice_zh: 饵料驯化(鲜活饵料向人工配合饲料过渡)
statement_en: The three claims mostly describe how the transition is done rather than measuring welfare outcomes: a mixed diet of semi-comatose fry and artificial feed with the ratio adjusted daily from 20:1 to 1:1 on days 6–10, then artificial feed only from day 11 to 25 with intensive management, and a 50:50 mix of commercial feed and minced meat. All three are described as supporting adaptation to artificial feed, but none reports a measured effect on welfare.
statement_zh: 这三条结论主要是在描述驯化的做法,并没有给出福利方面的实测结果:第6至10天用半昏迷鱼苗与人工饲料混合投喂,比例逐日由20:1调整到1:1;第11至25天只投喂人工饲料并加强管理;另一条是商品饲料与鱼肉糜各占50%的混合投喂。三条都认为这样有助于鳜适应人工饲料,但都没有报告对福利的具体测定效果。

practice_zh: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌
statement_en: The feed conversion ratio showed a trend opposite to that of the percentage weight gain.
statement_zh: 饲料系数呈现与体重增加百分比相反的趋势。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, high dietary carbohydrate generally reduced feeding: in one 8-week trial, daily feed intake was unchanged between 2.4% and 16.5% carbohydrate but fell significantly between 16.5% and 30.1%, and another study reported anorexia in fish fed an 8% carbohydrate diet, with sustained hyperglycemia inferred. Growth first rose and then fell as carbohydrate increased, and the highest-carbohydrate groups had lower weight gain and protein retention and poorer feed conversion; one measurement at a single time point showed no significant difference in feed intake.
statement_zh: 鳢类中的鳜鱼（Siniperca chuatsi）饲喂高碳水化合物饲料总体上会抑制摄食：一项8周试验中，碳水化合物在2.4%至16.5%之间日摄食量无显著变化，在16.5%至30.1%之间显著下降；另一项研究报道，喂8%碳水化合物饲料的鳜出现厌食，并推测其存在持续高血糖。随碳水化合物升高，生长先升后降，最高碳水组的日增重和蛋白质保留率较低、饵料系数较高；不过有一个时间点的日摄食量各组间差异不显著。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, moderate dietary choline (400–1600 mg/kg) raised expression of the appetite gene agrp, and 800 mg/kg raised feed intake rate, though only that one group differed significantly in feed intake and npy did not change. Very high choline (3200 and 6400 mg/kg) pushed appetite genes the other way (higher pomc and cart, lower agrp), raised energy-stress gene expression at 6400 mg/kg, and was linked to poorer growth.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼中，饲料添加适量胆碱（400–1600 mg/kg）可上调食欲基因agrp的表达，800 mg/kg时摄食率显著提高，但只有该组的摄食量显著高于对照组，npy表达无变化。胆碱添加过高（3200和6400 mg/kg）则使食欲调控向相反方向变化（pomc、cart上调，agrp下调），6400 mg/kg还使能量应激相关基因表达升高，并与生长下降有关。

practice_en: dietary C-I20 supplementation in soybean meal diets
statement_en: In mandarin fish fed diets where soybean meal replaced fish meal, adding C-I20 (160 mg/Kg) reduced the negative effects of soybean meal: it raised final body weight, weight gain rate and crude protein content, lowered feed conversion ratio, and improved intestinal morphology (cross-sectional area, villus length, muscle layer thickness). All four claims, from one paper, are supportive, and the authors interpret the main effect as easing the rise in feed conversion ratio caused by soybean meal.
statement_zh: 在以豆粕替代鱼粉的鳜鱼饲料中，添加160 mg/Kg的C-I20可减轻豆粕带来的不良影响：终末体重、增重率和粗蛋白含量提高，饲料系数降低，肠道形态也得到改善（肠道横截面积、绒毛长度和肌层厚度增加）。四条结论均来自同一篇论文且均为正面结果，作者认为其主要作用是缓解豆粕引起的饲料系数升高。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, replacing a low proportion of fishmeal (27.27% with a mixed animal and plant protein) did not reduce growth, feed intake or survival. A higher replacement (54.55%) significantly lowered weight gain and specific growth rate and raised feed conversion ratio, possibly through anti-nutritional factors, amino acid imbalance or falling feed intake. One paper reported higher daily protein intake and protein conversion efficiency at some replacement levels than in the control.
statement_zh: 对于鳜鱼，低比例鱼粉替代（27.27%，用动植物复合蛋白）没有降低生长、摄食量和成活率；高比例替代（54.55%）则使增重率和特定生长率显著下降、饵料系数显著升高，原因可能与抗营养因子、氨基酸不平衡或摄食量下降有关。另有一项研究报告，部分替代水平下的日蛋白摄入率和蛋白转化效率高于对照组。

practice_en: feeding domestication of mandarin fish to formulated feed
practice_zh: 鳜鱼驯食（条件反射驯化）
statement_en: Most claims describe stepwise feeding domestication, moving mandarin fish from live bait to dead fish, fish chunks and formulated feed, and report that many fish come to accept dead bait or artificial feed. Reported acclimation rates were about 70-74% after 15 days across three fish sizes, and in reservoir cages taming rates were 100% for fresh fish, 100% for fish chunks and 88.4% for formulated feed in 2-year-old fish. Some claims say only some individuals accept it, and none of the claims directly measure welfare outcomes such as stress or injury.
statement_zh: 多数结论是在描述鳜鱼驯食的做法:由活饵逐步过渡到死鱼、鱼块再到配合饲料,并报告不少鱼最终能摄食死饵或人工饲料。15天驯食成功率约为70%~74%(三种规格),水库网箱中2龄鳜驯食成功率为鲜鱼100%、鱼块100%、配合饲料88.4%。也有结论指出只有部分个体能接受,且没有结论直接测定应激、受伤等福利指标。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, raising dietary protein improved growth and feed use up to a point, and then growth levelled off or fell. In one measured study, protein from 32.61% to 56.30% gave a rise then fall in specific growth rate, with the lowest growth at 32.61% and 38.10%, the highest at 48.95%, and one paper reporting higher feed efficiency and protein conversion at higher protein.
statement_zh: 对鳜鱼来说，饲料蛋白水平提高时，生长和饲料利用先有所改善，超过一定水平后生长趋于持平或下降。一项实测研究中，蛋白含量从32.61%升到56.30%，特定生长率先升后降，32.61%和38.10%组最低，48.95%组最高；另有论文报道蛋白含量较高时饲料效率和蛋白转化效率也较高。

statement_en: In mandarin fish fed a maggot meal diet (replacing fish meal), adding taurine raised expression of the appetite genes npy and ghrelin and was reported to restore normal feeding levels and promote feeding, without growth or feed use being affected by the fish meal replacement. Much of the explanation (neural signalling, taste palatability, energy metabolism) comes from background literature, and the paper notes there is no direct experimental evidence yet for the taste-receptor mechanism.
statement_zh: 在以蝇蛆粉替代鱼粉的饲料中，给鳜鱼添加牛磺酸可上调食欲相关基因npy和ghrelin的表达，并被报道能恢复正常摄食水平、促进摄食，而鱼粉替代本身不影响生长和饲料利用。其作用机制（神经信号、味觉适口性、能量代谢）多来自背景文献，作者也指出通过味觉受体提高采食量的机制目前缺乏直接实验证据。
